items.title: Agents you can trust
items.subtitle: AI helpers look different from people, ask before anything final, and never claim success before it is confirmed. Try the approval demo.

items.title: Motion between screens
items.subtitle: How Cieo moves content when a view changes, so people keep their place: panels that resize, steps that slide, cards that grow from their button.

items.title: Color that stays readable
items.subtitle: Pick any Cieo brand color, in light or dark or high contrast, and text stays easy to read. Try it and see the checks.

items.title: Foundations
items.subtitle: Five promises behind every Cieo screen: motion that settles, smooth changes between views, readable color, calm type and shape, and agents you can trust.

items.title: Springs that settle
items.subtitle: Cieo motion glides to a stop instead of bouncing or jerking. Try the speed and bounce yourself, then see how a sheet snaps when you let go.

items.title: Type and shape
items.subtitle: One clean sans typeface for headings and body, five corner styles and three spacing densities, without ever shrinking a touch target.

items.title: Spring presets
items.subtitle: Critically damped step responses solved in closed form. No integration, no drift, no overshoot.

items.title: Retarget as a sum
items.subtitle: Each new target adds one spring from its own start time. The value stays a pure sum you can scrub or render offline.

items.title: Stagger
items.subtitle: The same spring started 40ms apart per item. Order reads left to right without any keyframes.

items.title: Tabs with panel
items.subtitle: Indicator edges lag each other. The panel text swaps with blur while the panel height morphs to fit.

items.title: Accordion
items.subtitle: Height springs to the measured body. The chevron turns on the same spring and the body fades in with height.

items.title: Tooltip
items.subtitle: Enters on the base spring from 97% scale and 4px below. Exits faster on the snap spring so it never lingers.

items.title: Dismissible alert
items.subtitle: Fades and blurs out first, then the space collapses so content below never jumps while text is still visible.

items.title: Flip card
items.subtitle: One rotation track on the soft spring. The card sinks 3% at the midpoint so the flip has depth without a bounce.

items.title: Stepper
items.subtitle: The connector fills first, then the next node inks in after the lag. Completed nodes swap their number for a check.

items.title: Rating
items.subtitle: While the pointer is over it, the fill follows the cursor exactly. On leave it settles back to the saved value.

items.title: Count badge
items.subtitle: Digits roll up one slot at a time and slot widths spring, so 9 to 10 widens smoothly. The badge scales in from 60%.

items.title: Blur swap label
items.subtitle: Outgoing text blurs up and out in 100ms. Incoming text starts after it, while the pill width springs to fit.

items.title: Counter
items.subtitle: The number itself rides the lazy spring, so it decelerates into the final value instead of ticking linearly.

items.title: Progress bars
items.subtitle: Fills stagger by 40ms and percentages count with the same spring, so number and bar always agree.

items.title: Line chart
items.subtitle: The line draws on the lazy spring through stroke-dashoffset. The dot and tooltip follow the nearest point on the snap spring.

items.title: Bar chart
items.subtitle: Switching datasets retargets every bar mid-flight with a stagger. Labels stay on a fixed 0–100 scale.

items.title: Donut
items.subtitle: Segments sweep in together on one spring. Hovering a segment thickens it and swaps the center label.

items.title: Timeline
items.subtitle: The spine fills to the current milestone first. The node inks in after the lag, then its row brightens.

items.title: Countdown
items.subtitle: Remaining time is computed from the clock each frame. Only digits that change roll, each on its own swap.

items.title: Before / after
items.subtitle: The divider sits exactly under the pointer while dragging. Clicking elsewhere springs it there instead.

items.title: Carousel
items.subtitle: Drag follows the pointer 1:1 with rubber-banding at the ends. Release projects the velocity forward to pick a slide, then settles from that velocity.

items.title: Marquee
items.subtitle: Offset is the closed-form integral of a speed spring, so slowing on hover is smooth and the position is still a pure function of time.

items.title: Gallery lightbox
items.subtitle: The thumbnail itself grows to fill the frame: position, size and radius each spring from its measured rect. Closing reverses into the same slot.

items.title: Player
items.subtitle: Play and pause share eight points on one spring. Progress is computed from the play start time, so scrubbing just rewrites that start.

items.title: Poll
items.subtitle: Each option morphs in place into its result bar. Fills stagger, percentages count up and the chosen row keeps a check.

items.title: Text field
items.subtitle: The label floats on focus. On blur the field settles into one of three states: neutral, valid in the success color with a check, or invalid in the danger color with a message.

items.title: Subscribe
items.subtitle: An invalid address rings the field in the danger color and opens a message. A valid one shrinks the button into a spinner, turns it success-colored with a check, then morphs the whole field into a tinted confirmation pill.

items.title: Signature pad
items.subtitle: Ink follows the pointer exactly. Stroke width thins with speed, and Clear fades the ink out on a spring before wiping.

items.title: Rubber-band slider
items.subtitle: While held, the value is the pointer. Past the ends the pill stretches with rising resistance, then springs back from release velocity.

items.title: Nav hover
items.subtitle: A hover plate follows the pointer with lagging edges and fades out on leave. The underline marks the current page with the same edge rule.

items.title: Header, progress, jump to top
items.subtitle: The progress bar tracks scroll 1:1. The header compacts once you leave the top. The back-to-top button enters after one screen and scrolls home on a spring that any wheel input cancels.

items.title: Mobile menu
items.subtitle: The three lines morph into a cross on one spring. The panel height opens and each link enters 40ms after the last.

items.title: Search expand
items.subtitle: The icon button widens into the field while the brand fades, and the input appears once the shape has mostly opened. As you type, results open below. Matching rows spring into place with the match in bold, misses blur out, and the highlight follows the arrow keys.

items.title: Pricing toggle
items.subtitle: The segment indicator uses lagging edges. Only the digits that change roll. The billing note swaps and the savings pill enters.

items.title: Add to cart
items.subtitle: The button confirms in place with a blur swap and fills with the success color, then returns. The cart count rolls when the item arrives, 300ms later.

items.title: Checkout totals
items.subtitle: Quantity digits roll, and every money value springs toward its new total, so subtotal, tax and total move together.

items.title: Switch
items.subtitle: The knob leads with one edge and trails with the other. While pressed it widens toward where it will go. The track inks in on the same spring.

items.title: Toast stack
items.subtitle: Success, warning and error toasts carry their status color on the icon and the action. New toasts push older ones back in depth. Drag one sideways 1:1; a long or fast swipe flings it out from release velocity, a short one springs home.

items.title: Dropdown
items.subtitle: The menu grows from the trigger at 97% scale while items fade in 30ms apart. Picking one swaps the button label.

items.title: Bottom sheet (mobile only)
items.subtitle: For phone layouts only: on wider screens Studio’s admin slides sheets in from the side (see Side detail sheet). Opens on the base spring. Dragging the grabber follows the finger; pulling up rubber-bands. Release past 30% or with a fast flick closes it from that velocity.

items.title: Command palette
items.subtitle: Rows spring to their new slots as the filter changes and hidden rows blur out in place. The highlight moves with lagging edges. Arrow keys and Enter work.

items.title: Morph surface
items.subtitle: Button, loader, check, dynamic island and toast are one element. Width, height, radius and ink ride springs, and the check fills with the success color. Content swaps by the blur rule. The run is a list of timed events.

items.title: Copy button
items.subtitle: The icon button widens to fit “Copied”, turns success-colored and swaps its content, then returns after 1.6 seconds.

items.title: Sortable table
items.subtitle: Sorting never re-renders the rows. Each row springs to its new slot with a 20ms stagger, and the header arrow turns on the same spring.

items.title: Table of contents
items.subtitle: The active marker tracks the section you are reading, with lagging edges so it stretches between short and long entries. Clicking an entry scrolls there on a spring.

items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.subtitle: Middle crumbs fold into one ellipsis button. Each crumb’s width springs to zero while its text fades, so the trail closes from the inside out.

items.title: Checklist
items.subtitle: The box fills, the check draws, and a strike line runs through the text, each 40ms after the last. The done count rolls.

items.title: Skeleton to content
items.subtitle: Placeholders pulse on a 1.2-second clock while loading. When data lands, each row swaps from skeleton to content 50ms after the one above.

items.title: Image blur-up
items.subtitle: A tiny blurred placeholder holds the space. When the image decodes, blur and a 4% overscale settle together on the lazy spring, so the sharpening reads as focus, not a pop.

items.title: Filtered collection
items.subtitle: Cards that leave the filter blur out in place. Cards that stay spring to their new grid slot, staggered by slot, and the grid height follows.

items.title: Donation amount
items.subtitle: The amount indicator stretches between chips. “Other” opens a field below on a height spring, and the button’s amount rolls digit by digit.

items.title: Date and time picker
items.subtitle: The selection disc glides between days on two axes. Time slots for the new day blur in 40ms apart after the old ones leave.

items.title: Paywall unlock
items.subtitle: The lock’s shackle swings open first. Then the gate card exits and the fade over the hidden text lifts from top to bottom.

items.title: Pay button
items.subtitle: Processing keeps the button in place with a spinner. Success fills it with the success color; a decline fills it with danger and opens a fix-it message. Both settle back to a retryable state.

items.title: Diagram build
items.subtitle: Each node arrives 180ms after the last, and each connector draws from its source only after that source has landed, so the flow reads in order.

items.title: Statement reveal
items.subtitle: Words enter one by one, 50ms apart, using the same blur-and-rise as a content swap. Nothing moves once the line is complete.

items.title: Multi-step form
items.subtitle: Panels slide sideways in the direction of travel with the blur swap. An empty required field rings in the danger color with a message; the final step confirms in the success color.

items.title: Select
items.subtitle: The list grows from the trigger. A highlight plate follows hover and arrow keys with lagging edges. Choosing moves the check, closes the list and swaps the trigger label.

items.title: Combobox
items.subtitle: Typing filters in place. Matches spring into their new rows, misses blur out, and the matched letters bold. With no match, an “Add” row takes the first slot. The list height follows the count.

items.title: Popover
items.subtitle: The panel and its arrow grow out of the trigger on one spring. Copy swaps in a success check, then reverts. Clicking outside or pressing Escape closes it faster than it opened.

items.title: Context menu
items.subtitle: Right-click, or long-press on touch, opens the menu at the pointer. It grows from that exact corner and flips when it would overflow. Items fade in 25ms apart; the destructive item is danger-colored.

items.title: Hover card
items.subtitle: Opens only after the pointer rests for 400ms, so passing over the link does nothing. Leaving starts a 150ms grace period, and moving into the card cancels it.

items.title: Confirm dialog
items.subtitle: The scrim fades while the dialog rises 8px from 96% scale. Confirming closes the dialog first, then the deleted row collapses, so the change happens where you are looking.

items.title: Navigation drawer
items.subtitle: The drawer slides in from the edge while its links follow 35ms apart. It tracks a drag 1:1, rubber-bands when pulled past open, and closes past halfway or on a fast flick.

items.title: Navigation menu
items.subtitle: Moving between triggers keeps one panel open and morphs its position, width and height to the new content. The content slides in from the side you moved toward.

items.title: Bottom navigation bar
items.subtitle: The active indicator pill grows outward from the icon’s center while the previous one shrinks back into it. Icon and label ink in on the same spring.

items.title: Pagination
items.subtitle: The number strip slides to keep the current page centered, clamped at the ends. The active plate moves with lagging edges, so it stretches on long jumps.

items.title: Radio group
items.subtitle: The inner dot grows from the center of the new choice while the old one shrinks, on the same spring. Arrow keys move the choice.

items.title: Checkbox with mixed state
items.subtitle: The parent box morphs its check into a dash when only some children are on. The three points of the check slide to a flat line on one spring, with no swap.

items.title: Toggle group
items.subtitle: Formatting buttons are independent, so each fills on its own spring. Alignment is single-choice, so one plate slides between options with lagging edges.

items.title: One-time code
items.subtitle: Each digit rolls into its box and a focus ring slides to the next box with lagging edges. A full code turns every box success or danger; a wrong code clears itself after a beat and the message says what to do next, announced to screen readers.

items.title: Tag input
items.subtitle: A new chip opens its own width before its text fades in. Removing reverses it: text out first, then the gap closes, so neighbors slide over instead of jumping.

items.title: Drag to reorder
items.subtitle: The held row lifts and follows the pointer exactly. The others spring aside the moment it crosses their midpoint. On release it settles into its slot from your release velocity.

items.title: File drop zone
items.subtitle: Dragging a file over the zone inks its border and tints it. Each file opens its row, fills its bar, then ends in a success check or a danger message. Files never leave your browser.

items.title: Extended action button
items.subtitle: Scrolling down hides the label first, then the button shrinks to its icon. Scrolling up reverses the order: the button widens, then the label fades in.

items.title: Action button fan-out
items.subtitle: Opening turns the plus into a cross and fans the actions out from the button, 40ms apart, upward, to the side, or along an arc. Labels follow their buttons in the straight layouts; the arc stays icon-only so labels never collide. Closing gathers them back in reverse order.

items.title: Avatar group
items.subtitle: Hovering the stack fans the avatars apart with a 30ms stagger. Hovering one face shows its name above it with the popover rule.

items.title: Shape-morph loader
items.subtitle: Like a drop of water: five ripples of 2 to 6 lobes are always present, and each swells and drifts at its own slow rate. Nothing ever switches or holds, so the outline flows continuously while it turns, and every frame still comes from the clock.

items.title: Resizable panels
items.subtitle: The divider follows the pointer exactly between its limits and rubber-bands beyond them. Releasing under 70px snaps the sidebar shut from your release velocity; a double-click springs it back.

items.title: Collapsible sidebar
items.subtitle: Collapsing fades every label first, then narrows the rail to its icons. Expanding widens the rail first, then brings labels back 30ms apart, so text never squeezes.

items.title: Long answer
items.subtitle: The box grows a line at a time on a spring instead of jumping. The counter turns warning at 90% of the limit and danger past it.

items.title: Number stepper
items.subtitle: Digits roll up when the value rises and down when it falls, so direction is readable at a glance. Holding a button repeats after 400ms, every 80ms, on the clock.

items.title: Phone number
items.subtitle: Digits format as you type for the chosen country. Switching country swaps the code with a blur and reformats the number. A complete number earns a success check.

items.title: Multi-select
items.subtitle: Ticking an option adds a chip to the trigger, which opens its width before its text appears. Unticking reverses it. The list stays open so you can pick several.

items.title: Matrix
items.subtitle: Each row has one dot that slides between columns instead of a fresh fill per cell. A row inks a success check once answered.

items.title: Time wheel
items.subtitle: Each column follows a drag exactly, then projects your release velocity forward and settles on the nearest value. Rows fade and shrink with distance from the center band.

items.title: Satisfaction faces
items.subtitle: One large face holds a continuous mood value. Its mouth curve and eye height follow the hovered or chosen score on a spring, so moving across the scale reads as one expression changing.

items.title: NPS scale
items.subtitle: The selection plate slides across the scale with lagging edges and changes color by band: danger for 0–6, warning for 7–8, success for 9–10. The caption swaps to match.

items.title: Click to rank
items.subtitle: Clicking an item gives it the next rank: a numbered badge grows in and the item springs up into ranked order. Clicking a ranked item removes it and closes the gap.

items.title: Picture choice
items.subtitle: Choosing a card presses it in slightly, inks its border and pops a check badge in the corner. Letter keys pick an option, as in conversational forms.

items.title: One question at a time
items.subtitle: Each answer moves the question up and out while the next rises from below. Choices take letter keys and confirm with a short pulse before advancing. Enter submits text, and the progress bar fills per answer.

items.title: Popup, slide-in and bar
items.subtitle: Three ways to show one sign-up form. A popup scales up over a scrim, a slide-in rises from the corner, and a bar drops from the top without blocking. Each waits 1.2 seconds, and closing is quicker than opening.

items.title: Prize wheel
items.subtitle: The wheel turns on a slow critically damped spring toward a precomputed angle, so it decelerates smoothly and stops without rocking back. The result swaps in once it settles.

items.title: Password with strength
items.subtitle: Meter segments fill in order as strength rises, shifting from danger to warning to success. Each requirement draws its own check when met. The eye icon’s slash draws on and off.

items.title: Range slider
items.subtitle: Each thumb follows its drag exactly and stops at the other thumb. Histogram bars inside the range ink in while the rest fade, each on its own spring.

items.title: Selection toolbar
items.subtitle: The toolbar appears above the selection and glides to the next selection instead of jumping. It leaves quickly when the selection collapses.

items.title: Slash command menu
items.subtitle: Typing “/” opens the menu right at the caret. Typing more filters it in place, the highlight follows with lagging edges, and Enter inserts a block that opens below.

items.title: Autosave status
items.subtitle: The status moves through Editing, Saving with a spinner, and Saved with a success check, then relaxes to a quiet “Saved just now”. Each change is a blur swap timed from your last keystroke.

items.title: Live collaborators
items.subtitle: Remote cursors glide word to word with name flags, and each person’s avatar joins the stack with a ring in their color. Positions are scheduled on the clock, so the scene replays identically.

items.title: Suggested edit
items.subtitle: Accepting fades the struck word and closes its gap, while the inserted word loses its suggestion color. Rejecting does the reverse. The sentence reflows on springs, not jumps.

items.title: Canvas pan and zoom
items.subtitle: Zoom keeps the point under the pointer fixed, so you zoom into what you are looking at. Pan follows the drag exactly and coasts briefly after release.

items.title: Select, move and snap
items.subtitle: Moving and resizing follow the pointer, but within 8px of the other shape’s edges or center the box is pulled into alignment on a stiff spring, and a red guide marks the match.

items.title: Color picker
items.subtitle: Both handles follow the pointer exactly while dragging. Picking a preset springs both handles to that color, so you can see where it lives in the space.

items.title: Layer tree
items.subtitle: Groups open and close on a height spring with their chevrons turning. The selection plate slides between rows with lagging edges, and hiding a layer fades its name while the eye closes.

items.title: Undo and redo
items.subtitle: Undo and redo spring the shape between saved states. A dashed ghost stays at the state you just left and fades out, so you can see what changed.

items.title: Swipe actions
items.subtitle: The row follows your finger. The action behind it fills with its color and its icon grows once you pass the 80px threshold. Release past it and the row leaves and its space closes; otherwise it springs home.

items.title: Undo send
items.subtitle: Send shrinks the draft away and a toast takes over with a ring that empties over 5 seconds. Undo brings the draft back exactly. When the ring runs out, the toast swaps to a success “Sent”.

items.title: Collapsed thread
items.subtitle: Earlier messages wait as a short stack of card edges. Opening the thread unfolds each message to full height, 50ms apart from the top, and the stack edges fold away.

items.title: Minimize to bar
items.subtitle: Minimizing flies the window down into a bar at the bottom edge. Its position, size and radius each spring from the window’s rect, and the body fades first. Clicking the bar restores it along the same path.

items.title: Search result preview
items.subtitle: The preview truncates exactly where a search engine would, as you type. Under each field a length bar fills on a spring and shifts from success to warning to danger as you near and pass the limit.

items.title: Score gauge
items.subtitle: The arc and the number ride the same lazy spring, so they always agree. The color shifts through danger, warning and success as the value crosses 50 and 80, and the verdict swaps when the run settles.

items.title: Keyword ranks
items.subtitle: On refresh, rows re-sort by rank on springs, rank digits roll, and each change chip swaps to its new value in success or danger.

items.title: Like
items.subtitle: The heart presses to 80% and settles back as it fills. The count rolls up on like and down on unlike, so the direction of change is visible.

items.title: Follow button
items.subtitle: Follow turns into an outlined Following with its width springing to fit. Hovering Following previews Unfollow in the danger color, so the destructive action is never a surprise.

items.title: Story progress
items.subtitle: The current segment fills from the clock over 3 seconds; earlier ones stay full and later ones empty. Tapping a side skips with a blur swap, and holding pauses the clock for this story only.

items.title: Character limit ring
items.subtitle: The ring fills with the length of the post. Under 20 characters left it grows slightly and shows the countdown inside; past the limit it turns danger, the number goes negative and Post is disabled.

items.title: New posts pill
items.subtitle: New posts gather quietly every few seconds and a pill drops in from the top with a rolling count. Clicking it inserts them at the top, each opening on a height spring, and the pill leaves.

items.title: Download progress
items.subtitle: The ring fills as bytes arrive, at an uneven real-world pace, while the icon swaps between download, pause and resume. Finishing turns the ring and icon success and the status rolls to “Open”.

items.title: Browser tabs
items.subtitle: New tabs open from zero width while their siblings make room; closed tabs fade their label, then collapse. The active surface slides between tabs with lagging edges and the page content swaps.

items.title: Page load bar
items.subtitle: While a page loads, the bar creeps toward 90% on an easing curve and never stalls at a fixed point. When the page arrives it springs to the end and fades, and the content swaps.

items.title: Pull to refresh
items.subtitle: The list follows the pull with growing resistance while the arrow turns to say “release”. Past the threshold it holds open on a spinner, a new item arrives, and the list springs shut.

items.title: Link preview
items.subtitle: Resting on a link opens a preview after 300ms. Moving to another link keeps the card open and glides it to the new link while the content swaps, so scanning several links stays calm.

items.title: Streaming answer
items.subtitle: Words arrive on a schedule and each one fades up out of a slight blur, so the text feels written rather than printed. A soft caret rides the last word. Stop freezes the answer where it is.

items.title: Chat send and reply
items.subtitle: Your message lifts out of the input and travels to the thread as a bubble. A typing indicator then pulses in a wave and morphs into the reply bubble, growing to fit the text before the words fade in.

items.title: Calendar event
items.subtitle: The event follows your drag, and its edges are pulled to the 15-minute grid on a stiff spring, so it feels magnetic without fighting you. The time label shows the snapped result.

items.title: Task board
items.subtitle: The card lifts and follows the pointer exactly. Hovering over a column opens a gap at the matching position while other cards spring aside. Dropping settles the card into the gap from its release velocity.

items.title: Call grid
items.subtitle: When someone joins or leaves, every tile springs to its new grid slot and the newcomer scales in. A ring follows whoever is speaking, fading between people. Muting draws a slash through your mic and tints it danger.

items.title: Spotlight tour
items.subtitle: The spotlight is one hole whose position, size and radius spring from target to target, so the dimmed area never flickers. The tooltip glides alongside and its text swaps with each step.

items.title: Offline banner
items.subtitle: Losing the connection drops a warning banner that pushes content down. Reconnecting swaps the text to a spinner, then to a success message, and the banner leaves after a moment.

items.title: Empty state
items.subtitle: Archiving clears rows top to bottom, 40ms apart. Only after the last one leaves does the empty state rise in, so the two never share the screen. Loading samples reverses it.

items.title: Drop a pin
items.subtitle: The pin falls from above onto the spot and lands on a critically damped spring, so it settles without a bounce. Its shadow sharpens as it lands and a single ring fades out from the point.

items.title: Pin cluster
items.subtitle: Opening the cluster sends each pin out from its center to its own place, 30ms apart, while the count fades. Clicking the map gathers them back in reverse order.

items.title: List to detail
items.subtitle: The card you pick is the detail view. Siblings fade and blur out first, then the same card’s x, y, width, height and radius spring from its measured slot to fill the frame while its image grows. Back appears as it lands, then the heading and two paragraphs enter 50ms apart. Closing runs it backwards: text out, card down into the exact slot, siblings return.

items.title: Master–detail inbox
items.subtitle: Choosing a thread moves the selection plate with lagging edges, the leading edge going first. The thread pane exits, then the next thread enters from the direction of its place in the list. Then the unread dot shrinks away and the count rolls down. Compose slides a sheet over the thread pane. Send closes it first, then a new row opens at the top. Under 520px the list and thread become one column and the thread slides in from the right behind a Back button.

items.title: Page transitions
items.subtitle: The header never moves. The underline slides to the new link with lagging edges. The outgoing page exits on the Swap rule, 100ms ease-in with a small blur, and only then do the incoming heading, paragraph and image enter 50ms apart. Cross-fade only fades. Slide also travels 28px, toward the side the link sits on in the nav.

items.title: Page editor
items.subtitle: The first click on a block springs a selection ring onto it, lights the outline plate and slides the inspector in from the right (a bottom sheet when narrow), without swapping fields. After that the ring morphs between blocks with x, y, width and height springs, the outline plate follows with lagging edges, and the inspector fields blur-swap to the new block. Typing in Heading edits the canvas live; a Background swatch morphs that block’s color. Escape, or a click on empty canvas, fades the ring and sends the inspector away.

items.title: Unsaved changes bar
items.subtitle: The first edit raises the bar from below and a small “Edited” marker fades in beside that field. Editing a field back to its saved value drops the marker and lowers the bar. Discard springs the language indicator and switch knob back and blur-swaps the name text at the same moment, then the bar leaves. Save morphs the button into a spinner, then a success check, the markers clear, the bar swaps to “Saved”, and leaves 1.1 seconds later.

items.title: Site header
items.subtitle: Scroll the page: the progress bar tracks the scroll position one to one, and once you pass 16px the header compacts, with its height, logo scale and shadow all moving on one spring. Hovering a link slides a plate between links with lagging edges. The search button widens into a field, folding the nav (or the logo, when narrow) out of its way. Narrow: the menu button morphs into a cross and the panel opens below the header, then each link enters 40ms after the last.

items.title: Product page
items.subtitle: Selecting a thumbnail slides the main image in the direction of travel, and the selection plate stretches to it with the leading edge first. The main image also follows a drag 1:1 and settles from release velocity. A color change morphs the garment’s fill, price digits roll, and the stock line blur-swaps. Add to cart runs in order: button confirms, a copy of the image arcs to the cart icon, the badge count rolls on arrival 400ms later, then the drawer slides in from the right when opened.

items.title: Checkout
items.subtitle: One bar fills as you move Cart, Details, Payment, Receipt, and panels slide sideways in the direction of travel with the blur swap. Changing a quantity rolls its digit first, then every money value springs to the new total together; shipping goes free at $100. Empty required fields ring in danger. Pay shows a spinner, then fills success and slides to the receipt, where the check draws and the total counts up. With Simulate decline the button and bar flash danger, a message swaps in, and you stay on Payment.

items.title: Pricing section
items.subtitle: The segment indicator stretches to the new side, leading edge first. Then the three cards change in one wave from left to right, 60ms apart: price digits roll and the billing note blur-swaps. The Save 20% pill enters once the wave has passed (it leaves at once on monthly). The Studio card rests lifted with its button filled. Hovering or focusing another card moves the lift and fill to it, and leaving returns them to Studio.

items.title: Analytics dashboard
items.subtitle: Change the range or the source and three regions answer in order, 80ms apart. First the stat numbers spring and each delta chip blurs over to its new sign and color. Then the line morphs point by point, left to right, onto a rescaled axis whose labels swap. Last the table rows spring to their new ranks while the view counts roll.

items.title: Notification center
items.subtitle: The bell opens a panel that pops out of its own corner. Clicking a row shrinks its dot, mixes its text to muted and rolls the badge down. Mark all read clears the dots top to bottom 40ms apart, rolls the badge to 0, then the badge exits. Every 5 seconds on the clock a notification arrives: the badge rolls up and, if the panel is open, the row enters at the top on a height spring that pushes the rest down.

items.title: Onboarding checklist
items.subtitle: Start setup swaps the welcome card for the checklist while the card height springs to fit. Opening a task slides its body out in place. Mark done runs in order: box fills, check draws, strike runs through, then 40ms later the ring fills and the count rolls, then the task closes and the next one opens. When the fourth lands the checklist fades, the card shrinks around the finished state, and the success circle draws, then its check, then the message, then Continue. No confetti.

items.title: Hero entrance
items.subtitle: Order: eyebrow, then the headline words 40ms apart, then the supporting line, then both buttons together, then the product image rises 28px with a slight scale from 0.98. Everything settles in about one second and then holds perfectly still. It plays again whenever it scrolls back into view.

items.title: Scroll-linked features
items.subtitle: Whichever feature crosses the panel’s middle brightens and the rest dim. The sticky visual retargets from the scroll position: its shape, size, radius and color morph to the new feature on a soft spring while the inner content swaps out then in. The step indicator’s leading edge moves first and the trailing edge follows 60ms later.

items.title: Testimonial wall
items.subtitle: Choosing a filter blurs out the cards that no longer match, right where they are. The remaining cards spring to their new slots, staggered 30ms by slot, and the wall height follows. Opening a quote first collapses any other open one, then grows the card in place; only the cards beneath it in the same column move.

items.title: Side detail sheet
items.subtitle: A row click dims the list and slides the sheet in from the right on the base spring. The rows behind stay live, so picking another row swaps the sheet content (exit, then enter) without sliding again. Drag the sheet right 1:1 with a rubber band on the left; release past 35% or with a fast flick and it leaves from that velocity, otherwise it settles back. Escape, the close button or an outside click close it and focus returns to the row.

items.title: Segmented control
items.subtitle: A measured two-edge indicator: the active button’s box becomes left and right-inset variables, and data-ind-dir records which way it moved. The leading edge goes now, the trailing edge follows 60ms later, so it stretches then settles. Label color morphs, arrow keys, Home and End move the selection, and there are two sizes.

items.title: Status chip
items.subtitle: One chip morphs through Draft, Scheduled, Live and Error: the background and dot colors cross-fade through weighted state colors, the label swaps (exit, then enter) and the chip width springs to the measured new label. Error grows a Retry button to its left, so the chip itself never moves; Retry goes to Scheduled and, a moment later, Live.

items.title: Scroll-fade row
items.subtitle: The row keeps real scroll position, and each frame it asks whether there is content beyond either edge. Only then does that edge’s fade mask grow in, on a spring, and it shrinks away as you reach the end. With four chips nothing overflows, so no mask exists; switch to eleven and the end mask arrives, then the start mask once you scroll. The arrows scroll on the same spring.

items.title: Inline editable field
items.subtitle: The value and the input are the same box: same padding and type, so nothing shifts. Click and the border and fill morph in while the text swaps to the input and the trailing check and cancel buttons arrive. Enter saves behind a short spinner, then the new value swaps in with a Saved check. Escape swaps the typed text out and the original back in. Invalid input turns the border danger and swaps in the message.

items.title: Theme toggle
items.subtitle: One button, and the glyph shows the destination, as in Gesso: the sun’s circle and the moon’s crescent are the same 48 path points interpolated, while the eight rays shrink into the body and fade. At the same moment a local preview card cross-fades every color between its light and dark palettes. Like Gesso, the choice is stored as a pin only while it disagrees with the system, and the status line swaps to say which.

items.title: Device toggle
items.subtitle: The three icon buttons share one indicator whose edges lag: leading edge first, trailing 60ms later. The preview frame is a single element whose width, corner radius, bezel and chrome height spring together from one device value, so going Desktop to Phone passes through tablet like a real resize. The page inside is container-queried: columns collapse, the nav folds to a menu and cards stack as the width crosses each breakpoint.

items.title: Running timer
items.subtitle: Start morphs one button: the width springs to the new label, the fill goes from ink to danger, and Start and Stop swap by the blur rule while the task select swaps to its title. The h:mm:ss readout is read from the clock, and each digit that changes rolls in as its own swap. Stop rolls the digits down to zero, and the entry enters at the top of the log while the older rows spring down a slot and the last one fades out.

items.title: Disclosure group
items.subtitle: Each group is its own spring, never tied to a sibling: the body height follows the measured content, the chevron turns a quarter on the same spring and the content fades in with the height. Spacing holds two nested groups that open and close independently, and the parent’s height follows whatever they are doing. Like the editor’s preference store, only your toggles are remembered; Reset returns every group to its default.

items.title: Delayed spinner
items.subtitle: The load starts a 300ms timer. If the result lands first, nothing shows: the list swaps and that is all. If not, the spinner fades in and blurs up on the base spring at 300ms, then stays at least 500ms so it never flashes, fading out on the snap spring once the result has swapped in. The strip below draws the same clock: the tick is the 300ms threshold and the accent span is how long the spinner was visible.

items.title: Between-blocks insert
items.subtitle: Hovering the gap draws a thin line with a plus. Clicking morphs the plus into a row of block choices, and the gap opens to make room. Picking one grows the new block from zero height at that gap while everything below slides down on the same spring.

items.title: Floating block toolbar
items.subtitle: Selecting a block raises one toolbar at its top edge. Choosing another block glides the same toolbar over: whichever edge leads the move goes first, the other lags 60ms. The block-type actions swap by the blur rule (text, image, button) while the toolbar widens or narrows, and move, duplicate and delete stay put at the end.

items.title: Block library panel
items.subtitle: Typing filters the tiles in place: misses fade out while the matches spring into the freed slots. Dragging a tile lifts a ghost that stays exactly under the pointer. Over the page, one accent line slides between blocks to show where it will land. On release the ghost settles into the slot and the new block opens to full height while the blocks below slide down.

items.title: Quick create
items.subtitle: The New button is one surface. Clicking grows it into a menu of kinds, whose rows rise in 35ms apart. Choosing a kind morphs the same surface into a one-line form that stretches across the header and fades the title out. Submitting turns it into a green Created pill, and only then does the new row open at the top of the list while the others slide down.

items.title: Shortcuts overlay
items.subtitle: Pressing ? dims the canvas and lifts the sheet in. The rows then rise in one after another, 35ms apart. Typing filters in place: non-matching rows fade out, group headings leave with their last row, and the remaining rows glide up. Escape closes it and hands focus back.

items.title: Step-up re-authentication
items.subtitle: Delete site is blocked until you prove it is you. A scrim fades in while the dialog rises 8px from 97% scale, with focus in the code row and the ring sliding box to box. A wrong code turns the boxes danger, says why, then clears itself. A right code turns the boxes and button success, the dialog leaves, and only then does the blocked action resume: the button reads Deleting…, the row fades out and its space collapses, and a status line swaps in.

items.title: Conflict recovery
items.subtitle: While you edit, a newer version arrives: the banner’s height springs open first, pushing the draft down, then its content fades in 70ms later. Compare swaps the draft for mine and theirs side by side, and the changed lines light up one after another. Keep mine or Use theirs swaps back to the draft (theirs blur-swaps the two changed lines), then the banner fades out, its space collapses and the chip turns Saved.

items.title: Approval card
items.subtitle: Deciding does two things in order. The status strip springs taller and its tint and outline morph from warning to success or danger while the label swaps. Then the Approve and Deny row fades out and its space collapses 100ms later, so the card ends as a stamp, not a form. Reset reverses it.

items.title: Field diff rows
items.subtitle: Each row shows the old value and Theo’s new one. Choosing a value draws a strike across the other and fades it, then the chosen one’s plate fills success 60ms later and the badge swaps. Accept all and Revert all run the same change down the list 70ms apart, the decided count rolls, and a header button turns ink once every row agrees.

items.title: Invite member
items.subtitle: Invite opens a form row at the top of the list and its height springs open. Send keeps that same row: the form swaps out for the member, the height morphs to fit and the chip reads Pending. Resend turns the chip success and Sent for 1.6 seconds, widening it on the same spring. Revoke fades the row out first, then its space collapses.

items.title: Reference row picker
items.subtitle: The list rises from the field with a plate that follows hover and arrow keys on lagging edges. Picking a row measures its rect and the chip starts there at the row’s size and radius, then x, y, width, height and radius spring to the chip’s slot in the field while the row’s text swaps for the chip’s. The row fades out and the rows below slide up; the field grows to wrap the next chip. Removing a chip fades it, then the others slide over and the row returns to the list.

items.title: Notice banner
items.subtitle: The notice slides down inside a slot whose height springs open, so the dashboard rows are pushed down rather than covered. Next notice cross-morphs the banner fill and border between info, warning and danger while the old copy exits and the new copy enters, never overlapping. Dismiss fades the copy out first, then collapses the slot height after 100ms, and the rows rise to fill it.

items.title: Consent banner
items.subtitle: The banner rises from the bottom edge. Customize does not open a dialog: the intro fades and its height collapses while the four categories grow in place and the title swaps, and the middle button swaps to Save preferences. Every optional switch starts off, the three buttons carry equal weight, and focus lands on Necessary only. After a choice the copy exits first, then the same surface morphs its size, radius and position into a small tab in the corner; the tab label enters last. Clicking the tab reverses it.

items.title: Bulk selection bar
items.subtitle: Selecting the first row opens a slot above the table: its height springs open and pushes the rows down, then the bar rises into it 50ms later with the count in rolling digits. The header checkbox morphs between empty, check and a dash for mixed. Delete removes the selected rows top-down, 100ms apart: each row fades, then its height collapses, and the count rolls down; the bar leaves only after the last row has gone. Archive swaps each status chip and Clear releases the rows the same way.

items.title: Snackbar with action
items.subtitle: The snackbar rises from the bottom edge while a thin bar under it drains over six seconds. Hovering or focusing the snackbar pauses the countdown and resuming pushes the deadline back by exactly the paused time. Open swaps its label to Done with a tint morph, the countdown freezes, and the snackbar leaves 0.9s later. Dismiss and the timeout use the same exit.

items.title: Avatar picker
items.subtitle: Choosing a preset cross-fades the picture: the new image fades in over the old one, which stays opaque underneath until the new one is whole, so the circle is never blank. The selection ring moves between presets with lagging edges. Upload draws a progress ring around the avatar while the picture dims, then the ring fades, the photo cross-fades in, and the status line swaps its message.

items.title: Date range selector
items.subtitle: The range is one tint plate per week row. When the end day moves, each row’s plate retargets with two edges: the leading edge goes first and the trailing edge lags 60ms, and rows farther from the start row begin 30ms later, so the highlight pours along the weeks. Hovering after the first click previews the range. Preset buttons animate the same plates, the endpoint discs scale in, the count rolls, and the label swaps.

items.title: Timeline scrubber
items.subtitle: The playhead follows the pointer 1:1. The record panel above always shows the latest step on or before the playhead date: when the playhead passes a step, the panel copy swaps (exit, then enter) and the two counters roll. Release projects the throw forward by the release velocity and springs to the nearest dated step. Arrow keys step between dates.

items.title: Revision history
items.subtitle: Each saved version shows a live relative time and its author. Hover or focus a version and the preview swaps (old text out in 100ms, then the new text in) to show what restoring would change: added words in a success tint, removed words struck in danger. Selecting a row opens Restore in place, which swaps to an inline confirmation, then to Restoring. Last, the removed words collapse and the tints fade so the current draft becomes the restored text, and a new entry enters at the top.

items.title: Annotation review canvas
items.subtitle: Click the design: a dot marks the spot, the pin falls onto it, and only then does a comment card grow out of the pin. Pins follow the pointer 1:1 when dragged and settle from release velocity, and the card travels with the pin it belongs to. Resolving collapses the card into its pin as the pin turns to a success check. The side list shares selection: its highlight plate moves between rows with the leading edge first.

items.title: Auth shell
items.subtitle: One card holds every pane, so the frame never changes. Going to Forgot password or Enter code, the old pane slides out 18px and fades (100ms), then the next pane arrives from the direction of travel. The card’s height springs to the new pane on the same tick, so it never jumps. An error opens a danger line inside the card and adds its height to the same spring. The primary button swaps its label while it works. Everything here is demo text and nothing is sent.

items.title: Funnel report
items.subtitle: Four bars grow from the baseline left to right, 120ms apart, and each stage count rolls up as its bar rises. The drop-off chip between two stages counts up just after the bar it follows. Changing the date range morphs every bar to its new height in the same stage order while the numbers roll, and the period text swaps. Hovering a stage dims the others and raises a tooltip that glides between bar tops and swaps its text.

items.title: Settings shell
items.subtitle: The nav plate edges between items, leading edge first, and tints to danger on Danger zone. Panes swap by nav order: going down they leave upward and the next arrives from below, going up the reverse, never overlapping, while the content area height springs to the next pane. Changing any control starts that pane’s own Saving… then Saved flash inline, then fades. Danger zone reveals a typed confirmation that grows the pane, arms the button only once the site name matches, and replaces itself with a scheduled message and Undo. Narrow: the nav becomes a top segmented row.

items.title: Connected servers
items.subtitle: Each row is one server. Its chip morphs fill, label and width between connected, connecting, error and disconnected while the action button swaps its label, so Reconnect never pops in. An error opens a message panel under the row. New rows grow in from zero height, then their content fades up; the list stays pinned to the new row as it grows. Replay re-enters the rows 60ms apart.

items.title: OAuth consent screen
items.subtitle: Each scope toggle springs its knob, and the Allow count rolls. Turning on a sensitive scope grows a warning line under it. Allow morphs the button row: Deny shrinks to zero width while Allow grows, fills green and swaps to Connected, then the scopes you left off collapse 40ms apart and the toggles of the kept ones swap to checks. Deny runs the mirror image and fades red. The link between the two tiles fills as the grant lands.

items.title: Tool call approval
items.subtitle: The card holds one request at a time. Next request swaps the whole request block, and the card height eases from the old height to the new one. Show all arguments grows the preview on the base spring and swaps its label. Allow once or Always allow swaps the buttons for a running line with a live timer, then swaps that for the result; Deny goes straight to the result. The card height follows each swap without a jump.

items.title: Tool call log
items.subtitle: Calls stream in on a run clock, newest at the top. Each row grows from zero height and its content fades up; the spinner turns on that clock, then swaps to a check or an error as the call finishes, and the duration stops counting. Several calls overlap, so more than one spinner can run. Pause freezes the run clock without losing the queue. Click a row to grow its arguments and result; failed rows open on the error.

items.title: Server tool permissions
items.subtitle: Switches spring one by one. Enable all read-only turns on every read tool still off, 60ms apart from the top, and the button swaps to a Read-only tools enabled label once none are left; flipping any read tool off brings the original label back. The filter indicator edges lag each other, and tools outside the filter collapse in height rather than disappearing. Enabling a destructive tool grows a warning line under it.

items.title: API key reveal and rotate
items.subtitle: Create key grows the form open and swaps its own label to Cancel. Creating collapses the form, grows the one-time reveal panel in its place and drops the new row in from zero height with a New tag. Copy swaps to Copied with a green fill and falls back after 1.8s. Done closes the panel and fades the tag. Rotate and Revoke open an inline confirmation under the row; Rotate swaps the masked prefix and reopens the reveal, Revoke dims the row, swaps its line to Revoked, then collapses it.

items.title: Server connection health
items.subtitle: Connecting walks four steps in order: each swaps its ring for a spinner, then a check, 450 to 600ms apart, and the chip morphs to Connected when the last lands. The latency number rolls digit by digit with each ping while the sparkline shifts one bar left and every bar springs to its neighbor’s height. Simulate outage drops the bars flat and morphs everything to the error state; a countdown rolls down, the first auto retry fails at Initialize, and the second succeeds. Retry now skips the wait.

items.title: Agent permission matrix
items.subtitle: Each cell is a checkbox. Toggling springs the fill and check, and the cell takes a full outline (ink for added, red with a faint check for removed) so the change is visible before saving. The pending panel grows up from the bottom edge and each change enters as its own row. The header chip morphs to Can publish or delete as soon as one of those grants is on. Save swaps to a spinner, then Saved, collapses the rows and settles every outline; Discard springs everything back.

items.title: Link groups with descriptions
items.subtitle: Hovering a top item waits 120 ms before the panel opens, with a hairline filling the wait. The panel grows from the bar, then its links rise one after another. Moving to another item keeps the panel open: its height morphs at once, the old links leave in 100 ms, then the new ones enter. At phone width the same groups become accordions in one sheet.

items.title: Featured card with links
items.subtitle: Hover waits 120 ms, then the panel grows from the bar. The promo card rises first, the links follow in a 30 ms stagger. Switching top items keeps the panel: its height morphs, the old content leaves in 100 ms, the new promo and links enter in the same order. At phone width the links become accordions and the promo moves to the bottom of the sheet.

items.title: Vertical tabs, hover to swap
items.subtitle: Hovering a row on the left waits 70 ms so a quick pass across the list changes nothing. The selection plate then moves with lagging edges, leading edge first, and the right pane swaps: old content out in 100 ms, new content in from the direction of travel. Arrow keys follow the same path. At phone width each category becomes a nested accordion.

items.title: Icon grid of products
items.subtitle: Tiles arrive on a diagonal: top-left first, each neighbor 30 ms later. One plate glides between tiles with lagging edges, and the hovered icon fills with the accent on the same spring. Switching from Products to Integrations morphs the panel height and swaps the grid. At phone width the grids sit inside accordions as compact tiles.

items.title: Search inside the menu
items.subtitle: Opening search grows the panel from the bar and puts the caret in the field. Each keystroke filters at once: rows that no longer match blur out in 100 ms, the survivors slide up into the gap, and rows that now match arrive last. The panel height follows the list. The highlight plate trails the arrow keys. On a phone, search takes over the whole screen instead.

items.title: Full-width image cards
items.subtitle: The panel unrolls from the header edge on one spring. Cards then arrive left to right: each picture rises first, its words follow 60 ms later. One plate trails the pointer between cards, and the picture under it eases up. Moving to another top item swaps the cards in place. At phone width the cards become a swipeable row inside each accordion.

items.title: Nested flyout, three levels
items.subtitle: Hover waits 120 ms before the first level opens. Each row waits 100 ms before its submenu flies out to the right. While you travel toward an open submenu the pointer is inside a safe triangle between where you left the row and the submenu’s edge: rows you cross on the way do not switch for 350 ms. Leave the triangle and the switch comes in 50 ms. Arrow keys follow the menu pattern; Escape closes one level at a time.

items.title: Morphing dropdown with caret
items.subtitle: There is one panel. Hover waits 120 ms, then it fades in with its caret under the item. Moving to another item never closes it: the caret slides first, the panel follows with lagging edges, width and height morph together, the old content leaves in 100 ms and the new content enters from the direction of travel. Leaving the bar closes it after 220 ms.

items.title: Command menu
items.subtitle: Hover Go to, Create or Account waits 120 ms, then the palette opens already scoped to that group. Moving to another group keeps it open: rows that leave blur out in 100 ms, the rest slide into the gap, the group’s own rows arrive last. ⌘K or Ctrl+K opens it with the keyboard; the plate follows the arrow keys and Enter runs the command. On a phone it is a bottom sheet with touch-sized rows.

items.title: Drill-down menu with back
items.subtitle: The menu button opens one panel (on hover after 120 ms, or on click). A row with a chevron pushes the next level in from the right while the current one slides back 30% and fades. The header title swaps in the direction of travel and the Back button fades in with the parent’s name. Back, Escape and a drag from the left edge all pop a level: the drag follows the finger 1:1 and settles from its release velocity.

items.title: Header: logo, links, call to action
items.subtitle: Click a link and the underline slides to it, the leading edge first and the trailing edge 60ms behind. Change the alignment and the link group glides across the free space between logo and actions. Sign in morphs the account zone: the width springs to the avatar while the buttons blur out and the avatar blurs in. Narrow: the burger becomes a cross, a drawer slides in from the right over a dimmed page, then each link enters 40ms after the last and Product opens as an accordion.

items.title: Header: logo centered, links split
items.subtitle: The logo stays optically centered while the links split around it. Hover grows a short underline from each link’s center; click widens it to a full underline on the same spring. The alignment option slides each half toward the logo or toward the edges, using whatever room is left after the account zone morphs. Narrow: burger on the left, logo centered, and the menu opens as a dropdown whose height morphs open under the header with links entering in order.

items.title: Header: links, logo centered, actions
items.subtitle: Each link fills with a soft plate on its own spring when hovered or focused, so moving across the row leaves a short trail. Signing in swaps Sign in and the button for a notifications bell and the avatar; the bell’s unread dot scales away when clicked. The avatar opens a menu whose rows enter 30ms apart. Narrow: the burger opens a drawer from the left edge over a dimmed page, and the account zone stays in the bar.

items.title: Header: utility bar and main row
items.subtitle: Scroll past 40px and the utility row collapses in two beats: its text fades first, then its height springs to zero 60ms later, so the main row rides up to the top edge and the shadow fades in. Scrolling back to the top reverses it: height opens first, the text follows 100ms behind. The page never shifts because the header floats over it. Narrow: the utility row disappears and its links move to the bottom of the dropdown menu.

items.title: Header: shrinks on scroll
items.subtitle: Past 16px of scroll the header compacts on a single spring: the bar goes from 88px to 56px, the logo scales from 1.18 to 1, the tagline folds away, the button height eases down, and the border and shadow fade in together. Back at the top it reverses on the same spring. Narrow: starts at 64px and shrinks to 52px, and the menu drops from beneath whichever height it is at.

items.title: Header: hides on scroll down
items.subtitle: Scroll down past 80px and the header slides up out of the frame on a fast spring, leading with its bottom edge. The first upward scroll of 4px brings it back on a softer spring, so it leaves quickly and arrives gently. It also returns whenever focus moves into it, when a menu is open, and at the very top. The label below reads the current state.

items.title: Header: transparent over hero
items.subtitle: Over the dark hero the header has no background, no border, and light ink. Scrolling 24px fills the background, fades in the border and shadow, and turns the logo, links and button ink from light to dark, all as one blend on one spring. Opening the narrow menu forces the solid state first so the panel never opens against a transparent bar. The button’s fill and text colors invert with the same blend.

items.title: Header: floating pill with plate
items.subtitle: One plate slides between links with lagging edges: it follows the pointer or keyboard focus, then returns to the current page when you leave. Scrolling lifts the pill’s shadow, tucks it 6px closer to the top, and folds the wordmark away so the pill narrows. The Pill option morphs the width between fit-to-content and full. Narrow: the same pill is a bar; the burger morphs it taller in place, its corner radius easing from 26px to 22px, and the links appear inside it one after another.

items.title: Header: side rail
items.subtitle: Hover or focus the rail and it widens from 64px to 232px first; the labels fade in 60ms later, each 20ms after the last, so text never spills out of a half-open rail. Leaving reverses it: labels go first, then the width closes. The active plate slides between rows with lagging edges. Pinned keeps it open and the page slides over to make room. Narrow: the rail becomes a drawer opened from a top bar, with labels already showing.

items.title: Header: search expands in place
items.subtitle: Press the search icon (or “/”) and the pill widens in place to 320px while the links, centered in the room left over, are pushed toward the logo; when they no longer fit they blur out instead of wrapping. The results panel drops from the field with its height following the number of matches; typing collapses non-matching rows and keeps the rest. Narrow: the field takes the whole bar, the logo and menu button fold away together, and Cancel slides in.

items.title: Header: announcement bar
items.subtitle: Dismiss the bar and its text blurs out first (100ms), then the slot’s height springs to zero 60ms later, so the header and the whole page ride up into the freed space rather than leaving a gap. Show again opens the slot first and brings the text in 100ms behind. It lives above a sticky header, so once you scroll it leaves with the page and the header stays pinned. Narrow: the message left-aligns and wraps to two lines, and the slot measures itself.

items.title: Header: minimal with fullscreen menu
items.subtitle: The page header is only a wordmark, the account zone and a Menu button, at every width. Opening swaps the label Menu to Close, folds the two lines into a cross, and expands a dark layer as a circle growing out from the button until it covers the page. The header recolors to light ink at the same moment, then each link enters 60ms after the last, and hovering one dims the others. Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.

items.title: Minimal footer
items.subtitle: Hovering or tabbing to a link draws its underline left to right on a snap spring while the text darkens; leaving wipes the line out toward the right. Back to top nudges its arrow up, then the page scrolls home on a soft spring and focus lands on the page heading. Wheel, touch or any key cancels the scroll mid-flight.

items.title: Centered footer with social icons
items.subtitle: Links draw their underline on hover. The social icons share one plate: entering the row fades it in under the nearest icon, moving along the row stretches it with the leading edge first and the trailing edge 60ms behind, and each glyph inks up as the plate passes under it. Back to top springs the page home.

items.title: Four-column footer
items.subtitle: Brand block and four link groups. As the footer scrolls into view each block fades up 10px, left to right, 45ms apart; scrolling back out resets them so the entrance replays. Links draw underlines, and Changelog, Status and Careers carry a pill or an arrow that nudges on hover. Layout is container-driven: five columns, then brand over four columns, then two by two.

items.title: Footer with newsletter signup
items.subtitle: Submit an invalid address and the field rings danger red while a message opens beneath. A valid one shrinks the button to a spinner, then resolves one of three ways: success turns the button green with a check, then the whole field morphs into a tinted confirmation; a server failure turns the button red with Try again; an address already on the list rings the field amber. Columns rise into view in order as the footer scrolls in.

items.title: Accordion footer on mobile
items.subtitle: Below 520px each column becomes a disclosure: the chevron rotates 180° and the panel’s height springs open while its links rise in one after another, 70ms apart. Other sections keep their own state. If the footer was at the bottom of the page the scroll stays pinned there, so the opening list is never pushed off screen. At wider widths the same markup is plain columns and the buttons disappear.

items.title: Footer with language picker and theme toggle
items.subtitle: The language button opens a list above itself (below if there is no room) that grows from the button; one highlight plate follows hover and arrow keys with lagging edges. Choosing a language moves the check, closes the list, and every footer string swaps: out in 100ms, back in, staggered 12ms apart down the page. The theme toggle slides one plate between System, Light and Dark while every color in the page below cross-fades on one spring; System keeps following the real page theme.

items.title: Footer with live status
items.subtitle: The pill is one element. Switching state morphs its dot and tint along green, amber, red on a single value; the label swaps out then in while the pill springs to the new text width. Next, the incident note opens beneath it (height first, then content) and, if the details list is open, each affected service dot changes color 45ms after the last. Clicking the pill opens the per-service list; if the page was at the bottom it stays pinned there as the list opens.

items.title: Sticky reveal footer
items.subtitle: The page is one layer sitting above a footer that is pinned to the bottom of the viewport. Scrolling is the only input: once the page’s bottom edge reaches the viewport bottom, reveal progress is (scroll + view − page) ÷ footer height. The page’s bottom corners round in over the first tenth, and the footer content drifts down 40px and brightens as it is uncovered. Until it shows, the footer is inert so Tab cannot land under the page.

items.title: Giant wordmark footer
items.subtitle: The wordmark is sized to the width of the footer and rises letter by letter as the page scrolls it into view. Each letter follows the scroll position on the soft spring, starting 35ms after the one before it, so p leads and l trails, and scrolling back up lowers them again. Link underlines wipe in from the left and leave to the right, and Back to top scrolls on a spring that any wheel or touch cancels.

items.title: Call-to-action band footer
items.subtitle: Once 96px of the band is on screen, the eyebrow fades up first, then the headline words rise out of their masks 45ms apart, then the actions and reassurances follow in the same order. The button is one element that morphs on hover: it widens to make room for the arrow, its corners round from 14 to a full pill, its fill turns from light to the accent, and it presses in 3% on the snap spring. Link underlines wipe in from the left and leave to the right.

items.title: Mega footer with sitemap search
items.subtitle: Typing filters the whole map at once. Every link that does not match steps back to 16% opacity with a slight blur, 5ms apart in reading order, while matches stay full and underline from the left. A column with no match dims its heading, the count rolls its digits, and no results opens a one-line hint below the field. Enter or the down arrow moves focus to the first match, Escape clears, and the slash key focuses the field from anywhere in the footer.

items.title: Footer with live widgets
items.subtitle: Time, conditions and the ticker are all computed from the clock. Picking an office rolls the hours, minutes and seconds digit by digit, rolls the temperature, and blur-swaps the icon and the condition text, 100ms out then in. Seconds roll once a second. The now-playing ticker moves at constant speed on a velocity track: hovering, focusing or pressing pause eases the speed to zero on a critically damped spring and resumes the same way, with no jump. Titles fade at the two ends by position, not with a gradient.

items.title: App download and trust footer
items.subtitle: Reaching the app block ripples the QR modules in from the top left corner on the lazy spring, one diagonal at a time. The trust badges rise 60ms apart; hovering or focusing a badge rings it in ink and pops a detail card above it from 97% scale, and Escape closes it. The store buttons morph their corner radius and fill on hover, social pills fill with ink and send the arrow up and right, and Copy link blur-swaps to Copied and back. Below 520px the QR is dropped because the phone is already the device.

items.title: Footer with more links and sticky strip
items.subtitle: More links opens a drawer under the toggle: the drawer height springs to its measured content, the chevron turns on the same spring, the three link groups rise 60ms apart, and the page scrolls just far enough to show the bottom of it. The label blur-swaps between More links and Fewer links. The strip stuck to the bottom of the page is one element that morphs between a cookie prompt and a one-line legal bar: the prompt text leaves in 100ms, the strip springs to the new height, and the legal row enters, with focus handed to Cookie settings so keyboard users keep their place.

items.title: Footer with map, contact and opening hours
items.subtitle: Today comes from the clock and is marked by a tint plate that slides between rows with its leading edge first. The status chip is one pill that morphs between open (success), closing soon in the last hour (warning) and closed (danger): it blends color, resizes to its new text, and the text blur-swaps. The Preview buttons set another time so you can see each state. The map placeholder drags 1:1 with a rubber band at the edges and glides on release velocity; plus and minus zoom on the soft spring, and the pin widens into its address label on hover or focus. Get directions fills from the left and empties to the right.

items.title: Full footer with staggered entrance
items.subtitle: The footer enters in one staggered sequence: eyebrow, headline, actions, newsletter, the four link columns, social, status and language, each 55ms after the one before, then the wordmark letters rise 40ms apart and the thirty uptime bars grow in. Scrolling away and back replays it. The newsletter field rings in danger for a bad address and opens its message; a good one shrinks the button into a spinner, then a success check, then the field gives way to a confirmation. The language picker pops a listbox above the button; choosing a language blur-swaps every labeled string out in 100ms and the new text in, one group after another.

items.title: Agent cursor
items.subtitle: The agent pointer glides to each target on a critically damped spring, an outline appears when it lands, and a quiet press-scale marks the click. In Browse mode the target presses; in Comment mode the click is blocked and a square agent pin drops instead, as in the review tool. Your own pointer is the round chip, 1:1 while you move it. Click the page to send the agent there.

items.title: Agent navigation
items.subtitle: When a page is requested, a thin load bar runs, the old page slides out toward where you came from and the new one slides in from the other side. Back reverses the direction. The URL path swaps with it, a chip joins the visited trail (leading edge first), and navigating after going back drops the forward pages. The badge says who drove it: the agent, or you with Back, Forward or a chip.

items.title: Follow the agent
items.subtitle: With Follow on, your viewport is a second, softer spring chasing the agent’s scroll, so it trails by a beat and never jerks. The moment you scroll yourself (wheel, touch, keys or scrollbar) follow breaks: the toggle turns off, the frame loses its accent edge and a Resume chip springs in, pointing up or down toward the agent. Resume glides from where you are to where the agent is.

items.title: Agent inspect element
items.subtitle: The outline snaps to the element’s box with its leading edge first and the trailing edge a beat behind, so the box visibly stretches between elements while the size readout counts to the new values. The label chip follows the top-left corner, then the inspector swaps and its accessibility checks arrive 45ms apart with the failing ones marked by shape (check, bang, cross). Inspected elements keep a result badge. Click any element, or switch Agent drives off, to take over.

items.title: Presence bar
items.subtitle: Each participant is a button: people are round, agents are rounded squares with a star and a square “Agent” tag, so nothing relies on color. Joining grows the slot first, then the avatar arrives; leaving fades first, then the slot closes. Activity chips swap text and morph width. Tap anyone to jump to the page they are on (the view slides toward their route and their cursor appears); it keeps following as they move. “My view” returns.

items.title: Site coverage
items.subtitle: The agent crawls one page at a time. The current row lights and spins; on arrival its links are discovered, so new rows open under it and join the queue 120ms apart. When the visit ends the dot morphs to a check, findings roll into the counters and the bar fills. Blocked pages (sign-in, downloads) end in a skipped state with the reason. Click a queued page to move it to the front.

items.title: Agent scroll map
items.subtitle: The map is the whole page squeezed into a strip. The agent’s window (tinted) stretches with its leading edge first as it scrolls; every band it covers fills from the left, the Seen counter rolls, and findings drop a square pin on both the map and the page. Your own window is outlined: drag it 1:1 and it settles from your release velocity, or click the map or a section chip to glide there.

items.title: Agent pin and comment
items.subtitle: The agent scrolls the page to the element, its cursor glides over, and a selector frame snaps around the target with the leading edges first. Then the pin falls onto the element and only then does the comment card grow out of the pin, carrying the agent’s name, an Agent badge shaped differently from a person’s round avatar, a severity chip and the element selector. Resolving collapses the card back into the pin, which turns to a check.

items.title: Agent and human thread
items.subtitle: The pin falls on the field and its thread grows out of it with the agent’s finding and a person’s question already in place. The agent’s three-dot indicator breathes on the clock, then its answer reveals word by word while the thread’s height eases open to follow it. Once it finishes, Accept and Dismiss fade in; either swaps to a one-line outcome with Undo. A reply from you appends a person’s message and the agent answers the same way. Resolve collapses the whole thread back into the pin.

items.title: Evidence capture
items.subtitle: The agent scrolls to the element and a capture frame snaps in around it, leading edges first with the trailing edges 60ms behind, while the rest of the page dims. The region flashes once, lifts off the page as a snapshot, and shrinks and travels into the tray, landing in the slot that has just opened for it. Only when it lands does the saved-screenshots count roll up. Open any thumbnail and it grows from its own slot into a viewer with who captured it and the element it shows; arrows swap between shots.

items.title: Agent suggested edit
items.subtitle: The agent frames the element and a suggestion card pops in beside it. Its words reveal in order: removed words get a danger tint and a strike that draws left to right, added words a success tint. Accept and Reject are one row that morphs: the chosen button grows to fill it and turns to a one-line outcome with Undo while the other collapses. On the page, accepting makes removed words close up and added words open out, and a style edit eases the button’s fill to the new value. Undo runs the same morph backwards.

items.title: Review summary
items.subtitle: Findings arrive one at a time, 130ms apart: each row fades up and opens its height while the severity counts roll up digit by digit and the Reviewing chip morphs to Completed. Severity chips are full-border chips and double as filters. Switching a filter closes unmatched rows to nothing while the rest slide up, and the Showing count rolls. Opening a finding eases its height open to the saved screenshot, the steps to reproduce, and expected against observed; opening another closes the first.

items.title: Agent comment queue
items.subtitle: When the run finishes the snackbar rises and its count rolls up as five pins drop onto the page 90ms apart. Review morphs that same snackbar into a sheet that steps through the pins: the page scrolls so the pin sits in the visible part above the sheet, the selector frame travels to it with leading edges first, the text swaps with blur, the count rolls and the progress plate slides to the new tick. Arrow keys and ticks jump directly; Escape or Done folds the sheet back to the snackbar.

items.title: Needs a human decision
items.subtitle: The agent pauses on a pin it cannot settle alone. The pin falls with a question mark and a warning dot, and its card grows out of it with a Needs a human decision chip. Choosing an option slides a plate between the three rows (leading edge first). Send answer closes the options and the button away, echoes your choice, and the agent’s acknowledgement reveals word by word. Meanwhile both status chips morph in place from warning to success to running, the pin’s question mark swaps for its number, and a one-line run status steps through what the agent does next.

items.title: Agent status pill
items.subtitle: One pill carries the whole run. On every change the shape morphs first (pill, rounded box, square, notched), the icon swaps, the label swaps and its width springs, and the action text grows out of the pill when there is one. Border weight and color blend with it, so state never relies on color alone. The elapsed timer restarts with rolling digits, and the button beside it swaps to the next sensible action.

items.title: Agent activity feed
items.subtitle: Each action lands at the top: its row grows from zero height, then the content fades up, while the agent cursor glides to the matching spot on the page. Consecutive actions of one kind fold into a single group whose title swaps and whose count rolls. Filter chips close non-matching groups instead of removing them.
