Click any row and the ring moves to that spot, leading edge first, and the page shows that moment; Back to live returns to following the newest action.

items.title: Take over from the agent
items.subtitle: Take over freezes the assistant where it stands. Its ink cursor fades and your accent cursor appears at the same point, then springs to the pointer, while a banner grows between the address bar and the page and pushes the page down, the buttons fold away and the queued actions slide open. Hand back runs it in reverse: your cursor travels to the assistant’s next target, turns into the assistant’s, the banner closes, and the queue starts ticking again.

items.title: Agent plan progress
items.subtitle: Steps tick on a spring: the mark swaps from ring to spinner to check, and the row’s substeps tick one by one under the current step, which is the only one open. When a step fails it stops the run, opens on the error and offers Retry or Skip; retrying runs only that step. Add step grows an input row, and the new step slides in after the current one while the bar fill and the rolling percent move to the new total.

items.title: Approval on the page
items.subtitle: Assistant’s cursor walks to the button and stops, the page dims, a ring closes on the button (leading edge first) and the popover grows out of it, above or below depending on room. The popover lists exactly what will be sent. Risky actions add a typed confirmation: the Allow once button stays off until the name matches and a check swaps into the field. A choice swaps the ask for its result and the popover height eases to fit; Always allow also slides a rule into the list.

items.title: Agent run replay
items.subtitle: The playhead is the only state: the page, the cursor, the typed text, the pins and the highlighted event are all pure functions of its position. Dragging it moves 1:1 and the page jumps to that moment; on release it coasts a few pixels from your release velocity. Play advances it at 1× or 2×, the event row at the playhead lifts and the list scrolls to keep it centered, and clicking a row glides the playhead there on a spring.

items.title: Multi-agent lanes
items.subtitle: Bars grow on the run clock, so a running task is a bar whose right edge is the playhead. When a task finishes, a handoff arrow draws from its end to the start of the next agent’s task, and that bar starts growing as the arrow lands. When two agents touch /signup at once, a warning band opens across both lanes with a marker; Queue Reviewer after slides the Reviewer’s bars later on a spring until the band closes. Clicking a lane grows it and swaps the detail panel to that agent.

items.title: Iris A/B: counter-scale vs clip-path
items.subtitle: A device test for an iris that opens from a ballot oval. The left pane scales a round window up while scaling the photo inside it down by the inverse (two Web Animations, transform only, so the compositor runs them). The right pane animates clip-path: circle(), which Safari and most browsers repaint on the main thread. Turn on Busy main thread to burn 12ms of every frame: the transform iris keeps its pace while the clip-path iris stutters. The drift readout shows how far the photo inside the counter-scaled window wanders between keyframe samples, and Ratio-bounded places keyframes so no two neighbours differ by more than 6% in scale, which keeps drift under a tenth of a percent. Open this on the real phone; the frame gaps shown are main-thread gaps.

items.title: Interruptible film scrub
items.subtitle: A four-chapter film on one Web Animations clock (push, iris, ink flood) with a chapter rail you can drag. Pressing the rail pauses every animation and hands the playhead to a critically damped follower, so dragging feels smooth even when the pointer jitters, and a fast flick coasts a little further. Releasing resumes playback only if the film was playing. Only animations whose scene overlaps the playhead get currentTime written each frame, which keeps a long film cheap to scrub. Chapter clicks can glide or cut; arrow keys step a second, Home and End jump to the ends.

items.title: Focal iris
items.subtitle: The next photo opens in a circle centered on its own subject, starting 10% large and settling, while the current photo pushes in 5% toward that same point and dims; reversing closes the iris into the subject. Use it when the subject matters more than the place, like portraits, products or a featured story.

items.title: Depth wipe
items.subtitle: The current photo slides off like a sheet and uncovers the next one behind it. The new photo travels less than the sheet’s edge, and its ground travels further than its sky, the parallax of a camera trucking sideways; a soft shadow from the sheet’s edge falls on it. Use it for places seen in order, like a travel story or a property tour, where direction means moving on.

items.title: Blinds
items.subtitle: Vertical slats turn one after another, starting on the side you swiped from: each face narrows and darkens as it turns away while the new face widens. A fast flick turns the slats almost together; a slow drag spreads the wave out. Use it when photos are browsed by hand, like a lookbook, and the gesture should be felt in the change.

items.title: Develop
items.subtitle: The new photo arrives by brightness, highlights first and shadows last, the way a print comes up in the developer tray: undeveloped areas pale toward paper, and each area gains its color after its tone. Use it when the frame stays in the same place and only the moment changes, like before and after or a time-lapse.

items.title: Rack focus
items.subtitle: Focus pulls off the current photo, which softens and breathes 4% larger like a real lens, while the next photo sharpens from its foreground back to its horizon. Use it to move attention between related shots, like a detail and the wide view, without implying a direction.

items.title: Horizon split
items.subtitle: The photo parts along its own horizon, the next caption shows in the seam, the seam slides to the new photo’s horizon, then the halves close on the new photo, which drifts in from the side of travel. Exit, then enter, never overlapping. Use it for chaptered stories, where each photo opens a new section.

items.title: Tile wave
items.subtitle: The next photo grows in as dots that open into squares, in a wave that starts exactly where you clicked, tapped or started your swipe; keys start it from the side you are heading to. Use it when the change comes from a place the person pointed at, like choosing a hotspot or a map region.

items.title: Page turn
items.subtitle: The photo lifts from its right edge along a softly bowed fold: its back shows through, mirrored and washed like thin paper, and a shadow runs along the fold onto the next page. Going back lays the page down again. Use it for sequences people read in order, like a lookbook, a catalog or a printed story.

items.title: Relight
items.subtitle: The same scene moves from midday to afternoon to golden hour along a light front that spreads out from the sun’s path, sky before ground; stepping to another place falls back to a plain dissolve so the light front only ever means “same place, new light”. Use it when only the time or the conditions change, like a lighting preview or a day-to-evening product shot.

items.title: Thumbnail to hero
items.subtitle: The thumbnail you choose lifts out of the strip and grows into the hero along a curved path: it rises first, then widens as it lands, while its slot stays outlined until it arrives and the old hero dims beneath. Use it for galleries with a visible strip or grid, so people see where the big photo came from.

items.title: Ink edge
items.subtitle: The next photo spreads in from the side of travel behind a calm, low-frequency ink contour that drifts slowly as it advances, with a faint darker rim like wash drying on paper. Use it for slower editorial pacing, where a hard wipe would feel mechanical.

items.title: Fly-to strip
items.subtitle: The view pulls back in proportion to how fast it is traveling, slides along the strip and settles back in, so a jump of five photos shows more of the set than a step of one, and dragging lifts it slightly so neighbours peek in. Use it when position in the set matters, like chapters or numbered steps.

items.title: Momentum filmstrip
items.subtitle: The strip follows the pointer 1:1. On release the velocity is projected about 0.4 s ahead and the strip settles on the nearest frame edge from that same velocity, so a hard flick travels several frames and a nudge moves one. Past either end it rubber-bands and the scroll bar shortens. Inspired by Keen Slider free-snap and Flickity freeScroll; changed: frames keep their real aspect ratios and the counter reports the range in view. Use when photos come in mixed formats and people skim them fast, like a contact sheet.

items.title: Inner parallax slides
items.subtitle: The frame follows the finger 1:1 while its photo drifts the other way inside it, and the caption runs slightly ahead, so three depths separate as you drag. The dot plate stretches from its leading edge and the trailing edge catches up. Inspired by Swiper parallax and Codrops slideshows; changed: every offset is computed from the slide’s distance to center, so it holds mid-flick, in reverse and when interrupted. Use when each slide is a place or a story and a sense of depth helps it read as a window.

items.title: Center-focus rail
items.subtitle: Each print scales and fades only by its distance from center, and spacing is integrated from that same scale curve, so gaps stay even and nothing rotates or overlaps. The caption under the center crossfades by distance while you drag. Inspired by Keen Slider’s distance-driven slides and Apple TV shelves; changed: positions come from integrating the scale, so the center print moves exactly 1:1 under the pointer. Use when one item is the subject and its neighbours are context, such as a print shop or a plan picker.

items.title: Swipe deck
items.subtitle: The top card follows the pointer 1:1 and tilts with its offset, toward the half you grabbed. Release projects position plus velocity: past 40% of the card it is thrown off at its own speed, otherwise it settles home without overshoot. The next card rises first and the rest of the stack follows 45 ms apart. Undo brings the last card back from the side it left. Use when every item needs a quick yes or no, such as triage, shortlists or review queues.

items.title: Stories with hold to pause
items.subtitle: Segments fill from the clock. Holding anywhere pauses at once and, after 300 ms, fades the chrome so the photo can be read. A tap on the left third goes back, anywhere else goes forward, with an exit-then-enter swap; each photo drifts slowly while its segment runs. Inspired by Instagram stories; changed: pausing, holding and time spent off screen are all subtracted from one start time, so the bar never jumps. Use when short, ordered moments should play hands-free but stay under the viewer’s control.

items.title: Synced thumbnail rail
items.subtitle: The main photo drags 1:1. The thumbnail plate is a pure function of that position: its leading edge reaches the next thumb first and its trailing edge follows, so it stretches mid-move in either direction and can never drift out of sync. The rail recenters on the active thumb and can be flicked on its own. Inspired by Swiper thumbs and Flickity asNavFor; changed: one position drives both, instead of two carousels messaging each other. Use when people compare similar photos and need detail and overview at once, such as product galleries.

items.title: Infinite loop
items.subtitle: Each slide is placed modulo the loop length from one unbounded position, so the track never resets, velocity carries across the seam and a flick can be caught anywhere. Across the seam the dot indicator drains out of the last slot while it fills the first, so it never jumps back across the row. Autoplay steps every four seconds and holds while hovered or focused. Inspired by Embla’s slide looper; changed: placement is computed per slide, never by cloning or teleporting the track. Use when a set has no natural end, such as postcards, testimonials or logos.

items.title: Peek and pull shelf
items.subtitle: Cards align to the left margin and the next one peeks in, so a phone screen always shows there is more. Dragging past the last card rubber-bands into a ring that fills with the stretch; past the mark the label swaps to Release, and letting go opens the full list as a sheet while the shelf settles back. Inspired by the App Store and Airbnb shelves; changed: the “see all” target lives inside the overscroll instead of a separate button. Use when a horizontal shelf sits inside a vertically scrolling phone screen.

items.title: Before and after lens
items.subtitle: The divider tracks the pointer exactly; a tap on the photo glides it to the tap and then tracks 1:1, and a fast release carries it a little further without overshoot. While held, the knob opens into a 2.25× lens centered on the seam, so both lights can be compared at the same pixel; on touch the lens floats above the finger. It is a real slider: arrows, Shift, Page keys, Home and End, and Enter or Magnify keep the lens open. Inspired by Juxtapose and the iOS text loupe. Use when two aligned images differ in detail, such as edits, relights, or before and after.

items.title: Vertical reel
items.subtitle: Vertical drag is 1:1 and a flick moves at most one reel, like Reels and Shorts; captions trail their photo slightly so the move reads as depth. Pulling up past the last reel fills a ring; released past the mark, the next four are appended and the same release velocity carries straight into the first of them. The arrow keys and buttons do the same, including loading the next set. Use when each item fills a phone screen and people move through them one at a time.

items.title: Masonry row carousel
items.subtitle: Photos keep their exact aspect ratios: tall ones span both rows and wide ones pair up in a column whose width makes both fit exactly. The rail free-scrolls with momentum and snaps to column edges; selecting shrinks the photo inside its frame and fills the check. Tab walks every photo and the rail follows focus. Inspired by Google Photos’ justified grid; changed: packed by column so it scrolls sideways. Use when portrait and landscape photos must be picked quickly without cropping them.

items.title: Route-linked carousel
items.subtitle: The carousel position is the hiker’s place on the trail: the marker, the inked part of the route, the clock and the mile counter are all computed from the same scroll value, and each stop’s photo is lit for its hour, warming from midday to golden hour. Dragging the marker along the map scrubs the carousel, and arrow keys step stop to stop on either one. Inspired by Strava route replays and Apple Maps guides; changed: the map is a second handle on one rail, not a separate view. Use when slides happen in a place or in sequence and showing where you are matters, such as itineraries, tours or timelines.

items.title: Grid to lightbox, shared element
items.subtitle: Press a tile and that same photo grows out of it: position, size, crop and corner radius all spring from the tile to the viewer, while the grid behind it dims. The caption and controls arrive only after the photo is most of the way there. Stepping to the next photo is a Swap, so the old one leaves in the direction of travel before the new one arrives. Closing runs the controls out first, then flies the photo back into whichever tile it ended on. Use when a grid of thumbnails needs a viewer that keeps the user oriented.

items.title: Swipe down to dismiss
items.subtitle: Open a photo and drag it anywhere: it follows the pointer one to one and shrinks about the point you hold as you pull down, while the scrim fades with the distance and the controls fade out within the first 70 pixels. On release the pointer velocity decides: a fast flick or more than a fifth of the height hands the photo to the shared-element flight back to its tile, keeping the finger speed, and anything less springs back to center. Use when a viewer needs the natural, touch-first way out.

items.title: Lightbox with pinch, wheel and double-tap zoom
items.subtitle: The photo is a transform, not a layout: two fingers scale it about their midpoint while the midpoint drags it, a double-tap zooms to the exact point tapped, and Ctrl plus wheel (a trackpad pinch) zooms about the cursor without taking over normal scrolling. Pull past an edge and the image resists on a rubber band that grows harder the further you go; let go and a critically damped spring returns it, carrying the flick as glide that stops at the edge instead of bouncing off it. A locator in the corner shows which part you are looking at. Switching photos is a Swap that resets the zoom while the picture is invisible. Use when photographs need inspecting at pixel level.

items.title: Filterable masonry that reflows
items.subtitle: Choosing a subject runs three beats in order. Photos that no longer match shrink to their own center in 100ms, staggered 20ms apart. Then the photos that stay travel to their new slots on a soft spring, one every 30ms in reading order so the reflow sweeps rather than jumps. Last, photos that now match grow in from their own center, 200ms in. The pill behind the active filter is a two-edge indicator (leading edge first, trailing edge 60ms behind) and the count rolls its digits. Use when a gallery filters in place and people should keep track of what moved where.

items.title: Collection to collection morph
items.subtitle: Twelve photographs are one set of elements that every collection arranges differently: a lead image with a grid, a plain grid, justified rows, tall columns. Switching runs in order. Photos not in the next collection shrink away first. Photos that are in both travel to their new slots, re-cropping as they go (a landscape becomes a tall column without a jump cut), starting 80ms later and staggered by their new position. Photos that are new to the collection grow in last. The title swaps on the same schedule: out, then in. Use when albums, smart collections or saved sets share photos and the user should see what carried over.

items.title: Contact sheet with a loupe
items.subtitle: A round loupe follows the pointer on a snap spring, so it trails the hand by a few frames instead of being glued to it. What it shows is the sheet itself, scaled 3.4 times about the lens center, so frames cross the glass continuously and picks you have marked show up inside it. The lens pops in on enter and out on leave, and its label swaps (out, then in) as the center crosses from one frame to the next. On touch the lens sits above the finger so it is never hidden by it; from the keyboard it parks on the focused frame. Use when people must judge sharpness or expression across many small frames without opening each one.

items.title: Photo stack that fans out
items.subtitle: Seven prints sit in a loose pile, each tilted a few degrees. Hover (or tap) and the top print leaves first, then each one beneath it 35ms later, all swinging out about the base of the pile into an arc. The print under the pointer lifts along its own axis while its neighbours lean away from it, and which print that is comes from the angle to the base, not from what is under the cursor, so a lifting print never flickers. Pick one and it travels to the top of the pile as the rest close from the bottom up. Use when a collection needs a compact, tactile preview that opens in place.

items.title: Hover-focus grid
items.subtitle: The photo under the pointer stays exactly as it is and gains a small caption. Every other photo quietly drains of color, dims and settles back 3.5 percent, and it does so in a wave: the nearest neighbours go first, the far corner last, about 14ms per 100 pixels. Moving to another photo retargets the same springs, so nothing restarts. Leaving the grid returns everything on the slow spring, over about half a second. Click or tap pins the focus so touch screens and keyboards get the same state; Escape releases it. Use when a portfolio grid should direct attention without hiding the rest.

items.title: Caption and metadata drawer
items.subtitle: The drawer is one number, how far it is open, and everything reads from it. The drawer rises on a soft spring (or follows your finger one to one on its handle, and release velocity picks open or closed); the photo, 50ms behind it, slides up and shrinks just enough that the marked subject ends 16px above the drawer’s top edge, and not a pixel more. Turn on the subject marker to see the area it protects. Detail rows then fade up one after another as the drawer passes each threshold. Changing photo is a Swap, and the new photo gets its own subject maths. Use when a lightbox needs captions and EXIF without covering what the picture is about.

items.title: Cull deck: keep or reject by throwing
items.subtitle: The top photo follows the pointer one to one and tilts with how far it has traveled, while the photo beneath it rises and grows by exactly the same amount, so the deck advances as you pull rather than after you let go. Let go and the throw is judged by where it was heading: distance plus a fifth of a second of velocity. A keep carries your speed into a flight that shrinks and re-crops the photo into the next empty slot of the tray. A reject leaves on the other side and fades. Undo returns the last photo along its own path, and the tray slot empties. Keys do the same with no velocity. Use when a shoot has to be sorted quickly and every decision should leave a visible trace.

items.title: Pinned hero zoom-out
items.subtitle: Use when a landing page should open on one striking detail and then reveal the whole image. The photo starts zoomed to the lit ridge and full bleed; scrolling pulls the camera back (log-scale zoom) while the window shrinks into a framed print with rounded corners. Only after the zoom settles do the three headline lines rise out of their masks, 8% of scroll apart, then the caption. Reduced motion shows the framed end state and fades the lines in.

items.title: Pinned horizontal gallery
items.subtitle: Use when a short run of related photos sits inside a long page and a carousel would hide them behind buttons. The section pins while the row has travel left: each pixel scrolled down moves the row one pixel left, smoothed by the follower. Inside every card the photo drifts against the travel by up to 10% of its width (depth), the progress line fills, and the counter changes as a card crosses the center. Reduced motion keeps the 1:1 travel and drops the inner drift.

items.title: Stacking cards
items.subtitle: Use when an ordered process of three to five steps should replace one step with the next while the earlier ones stay visible. Cards pin 12px apart; as the next card rises over one, that card scales down from its top edge (5% per card above it) and dims, so the stack recedes in depth while its edges stay readable. Coverage is computed from the next card’s distance to its own pin, so scrolling back lifts them out in reverse. Reduced motion keeps the dimming and drops the scale.

items.title: Clip window to full bleed
items.subtitle: Use when a page should move from editorial text into an immersive photo without a hard cut. The photo sits behind a small rounded window; scrolling opens the clip-path toward full bleed with the top and bottom edges leading and the sides lagging 8% of scroll behind, while the photo eases from 1.18× to 1×. The headline rides the top edge out, the note rides the bottom edge, and the caption tag fades in last. Reduced motion cuts from window to full bleed at the midpoint.

items.title: Chapter scrollytelling
items.subtitle: Use when each block of a narrative has its own picture: a case study, a trip, a product tour. Text steps scroll on the left while the photo pins on the right (on phones the photo pins full height and the steps scroll over it as cards). The photo holds while a step is centered, then in the gap between steps the next photo rises from below through a mask while the old one drifts up 18%, both tied to scroll so it reverses exactly. The caption swaps (exit, then enter) at the midpoint and the active step brightens. Reduced motion cross-fades.

items.title: Parallax depth planes
items.subtitle: Use when a hero should feel spatial without 3D assets. One PhotoKit scene is cut into planes in the page: per column, flat runs are found from the bottom up and clustered into ridge tones; the sky is the back plane. Scrolling moves each plane by its depth (sky 8%, far ridge 25%, near slope 100% of a 16% range), and the headline sits between the far and middle ridges, so it rises from behind the hills. Reduced motion holds the planes still and fades the headline in.

items.title: Relight as you read
items.subtitle: Use when the photo should keep pace with long-form reading: an essay, a case study, a place. As you read, the city relights from noon to golden hour. The warm exposure arrives as a soft band sweeping from the sun’s corner (top right) toward the bottom left, so light visibly travels across the scene; the time tag counts with it and the paragraph being read brightens. Reduced motion replaces the sweep with an even cross-fade.

items.title: Scroll-scrubbed sequence
items.subtitle: Use when a product or place reveal should feel like video but stay under the reader’s control. 24 frames are generated from one PhotoKit scene with the sun sinking (tod 0 → 1), lazily and nearest-to-the-playhead first. Scroll position is the playhead: the follower-smoothed index picks two neighbouring frames and blends them by the fraction between, so slow scrolling never steps. The tick rail and clock follow the same index. Reduced motion shows the nearest frame without blending.

items.title: Chapter rail with gentle snap
items.subtitle: Use when readers of a long guide or documentation page jump between sections. The rail shows every chapter with a bar that fills as you read it (one bar per chapter, sized to its length); clicking a chapter glides there on a soft spring. Snap is off by default; when on, it waits until you have stopped scrolling for 180ms and only pulls if a chapter start is within 22% of the view, so it settles rather than grabs, and any wheel, touch or key cancels it. Narrow, the rail becomes a segmented bar across the top. Reduced motion jumps.

items.title: Contact sheet to print
items.subtitle: Use when a case study or portfolio piece should show the edit, not just the result. Three acts on one pinned sheet: a loupe travels the contact sheet frame by frame in reading order and settles on the keeper (0–32%); a grease-pencil box draws around it (32–46%); then the sheet pushes in around that frame and fades while the frame itself grows into the full-bleed print, so the print visibly comes from its cell (46–92%), and the caption arrives last. All of it is scrubbed by scroll. Reduced motion cuts between the three states.

items.title: Progressive photo load
items.subtitle: A blurred 0.6 KB placeholder holds the layout from the first frame. When the real file lands it develops like a print in the tray: shadows come up first, then midtones, highlights last, over one second. Cached photos skip the reveal entirely, because animating something already there reads as lag. Use when: a feed, gallery or hero loads large photos over slow networks and the layout must not jump.

items.title: Hover rack focus
items.subtitle: Depth comes from the photo itself: each tree row is a flat tone and farther rows are hazier, so luminance sorts into planes. Point anywhere and focus pulls to that plane on a slow critically damped spring while the reticle tightens; blur everywhere else scales with distance from the focal plane and the aperture. Use when: a hero or product shot should guide the eye to what the pointer or the copy is talking about.

items.title: Brand tint to color
items.subtitle: Every photo is gradient-mapped through three tokens (darkest neutral, a tint, lightest neutral), so mixed sources read as one set in both themes. The story under the pointer or keyboard focus cross-fades back to full color on a soft spring; switching the tint dissolves old map into new. Use when: a grid mixes photos from many sources and needs one calm brand look, with color reserved for the item you are on.

items.title: Relight with the sun
items.subtitle: Two pixel-aligned exposures of the same ridge, midday and golden hour, blend through a soft light mask centered on the sun: light near the sun warms first, the far side last. Drag the sun along its path (1:1, then it coasts on release velocity) and it sets behind the real ridge line. Use when: a hero photo should follow the visitor’s local time or the mood of a page, without shipping a second photo set.

items.title: Depth parallax
items.subtitle: The photo is split into planes by aerial perspective (farther ridges are lighter). The pointer offsets each plane by its depth around a pivot at the middle ridge: sky and far ridge drift against the pointer, the foreground follows it, at most about 1% of the width. Planes ride a lazy spring and drift home when the pointer leaves. Use when: a landing hero needs a sense of place without video, and the photo must stay fully readable.

items.title: Halftone to photo
items.subtitle: The hero arrives as print: an ink screen whose dot sizes carry the photo’s tones in the page’s own ink and paper colors. It then resolves over 2.2 s: the screen gets finer, the dots take on the photo’s color, and the last stretch dissolves into the full photograph. Scrub it, or pick dots or a 15° line screen. Use when: an editorial or campaign hero wants a printed, considered entrance that still ends on the real photo.

items.title: Grade with live histogram
items.subtitle: Exposure and white balance are applied in linear light, and the same curve runs on a 1/8-size copy to draw the histogram, so the graph slides with the photo as you scrub. Drag sideways on the photo for exposure, or use the sliders. Auto exposes to the right (the 98th percentile lands just under white) with half a gray-world balance; Auto and Reset glide there on a soft spring. Clipped highlights and crushed shadows can be painted in danger and accent. Use when: people adjust uploads in a media library or editor and need to see what they are losing.

items.title: Paint in color
items.subtitle: A soft brush paints the color photo through a black-and-white print. Every cell of the mask stores when it was painted, so the heal is a pure function of time: it holds for 1.4 s, then the color drains back over 2.6 s, and painting again resets the hold. Reveal all opens from the center outward. Use when: a story or campaign hero invites people to explore, or to show what a restoration or colorisation changed.

items.title: Face-safe Ken Burns
items.subtitle: Each photo carries a focal box (the face, or the subject). The planner works out the largest zoom that still contains the box at this frame’s aspect ratio, then pans and zooms between two valid framings over seven seconds, clamping every frame so the face is never cut. If the frame is too wide even at full size, it zooms out over a blurred extension of the same photo instead of cropping the head. Slides cross-fade for 1.2 s while still moving. Use when: a hero slideshow or story cover animates portraits that must survive phone, tablet and desktop crops.

items.title: Fade flicker compare
items.subtitle: Blink comparison without the flash: versions dissolve in linear light over about 200 ms, so brightness never dips mid-fade and the eye still catches what moved. Hold Space or press on the photo to peek at the other version; Flicker alternates every 1.2 s until stopped; Difference paints only what changed. The version label swaps (exit, then enter) in step. Use when: reviewers approve an edit, a re-export or a new version and the change is subtle.

items.title: Frost behind captions
items.subtitle: The whole photo starts frosted, then clears in a wave that runs from the far corners toward the caption, leaving frost hugging only the actual lines of text (measured from the live DOM, so it follows wrapping and edits). The frost is blurred, grain-dithered, and toned just enough to reach 6:1 contrast under its worst patch, and the readout shows the ratio with and without it. Use when: captions or headlines sit on busy photos and must pass contrast without a heavy box or gradient.

items.title: Theme from photo
items.subtitle: Original: the cover photo proposes the site’s accent. Five colors are clustered in OKLab and listed by share. Hovering or arrowing to one spotlights where it lives in the photo (everything else dims to gray), and choosing it morphs the preview button to that color, with text flipped to whichever of white or ink passes contrast. Changing the cover cross-fades photo and palette together. Use when: a site builder or profile lets people pick theme colors that actually belong to their imagery.

items.title: Manuscript binder
items.subtitle: A chapter list with a highlight plate that glides from chapter to chapter on a calm spring, its lower edge trailing 60ms behind. Each chapter keeps a live word count that rolls over like digits, and picking a chapter springs the article pane to its heading.

items.title: Corkboard cards
items.subtitle: Scene cards follow the pointer one to one while held. On release every card springs home to its slot on the same calm spring with a 40ms stagger, and the synopsis line below swaps to the held card with a quick blur out and back in.

items.title: Focus sentence
items.subtitle: One sentence at a time carries full ink while the rest sink to a dim gray on the same soft spring. Moving the caret simply retargets that spring, so focus bends mid-flight instead of restarting.

items.title: Typewriter lock
items.subtitle: The caret stays pinned to the middle of the screen while the paper glides beneath it on a soft spring. A lock switch in the tile turns the effect off, so the caret walks the page instead of the page walking to it.

items.title: Goal ring
items.subtitle: A ring and its word count climb toward the daily target on a slow lazy spring, digits rolling as they go. At one hundred percent the ring gives a quick snap pulse and swaps to a Done state, and Reset returns it to zero.

items.title: Joined scenes
items.subtitle: Tick scenes to stitch them into one scroll. Divider titles swap without overlap while the joined height springs to fit.

items.title: Bare-page fade
items.subtitle: Enter fades the chrome out fast, then the page widens on a spring. Moving to the top brings the tools back. The toggle picks calm or busy air.

items.title: Compile run
items.subtitle: Run creeps the bar to most of the way on the clock, then springs it shut. Chapter ticks land one after another and the status swaps to open the book.

items.title: Live transcription caret
items.subtitle: Words blur in one by one while a soft caret rides the last word. Tapping a word pulses it like a replay. Pause stops the stream.

items.title: Pull-quote extractor
items.subtitle: Drag the quote and it lifts while the paragraphs spring aside. Dropping it grows the block open from zero height. Reset puts it back.

items.title: Deadline ticker
items.subtitle: The minutes and seconds roll on lazy springs while the plate edges trail 60ms behind. Under ten minutes the tile turns danger. Pause freezes the count in place.

items.title: Source fact-check chips
items.subtitle: Each source swaps from unverified to verified in 100ms exit-then-enter while the chip width springs to fit. Verify all runs the same change down the row.

items.title: Embargo countdown
items.subtitle: Only the digits that change roll each second. At zero the count lifts into a Live pill on a soft spring. Reset puts the count back.

items.title: Lede optimizer
items.subtitle: Variants swap exit-then-enter while the grade bar eases on base and the score rolls with the direction of travel. Prev and Next walk the list.

items.title: Audio-note insert
items.subtitle: The tile lifts under your pointer and follows it. Dropping it over the draft draws the waveform bar by bar on soft and opens the slot on a height spring. Play and Insert do the same without dragging.

items.title: Wire-feed ticker
items.subtitle: New wires slide in at the top and push older wires down, each one following 60ms after the last. The badge count rolls to the new total. Pause stops the feed.

items.title: Style gallery painter
items.subtitle: Hovering a style plate slides its highlight over, the style name swaps, and the doc preview retargets size and tint. Leaving keeps the last style.

items.title: Template inserter
items.subtitle: Tiles rise in one after another. Picking one grows the doc block open and swaps its content in. Picking again swaps to the new template.

items.title: Tracked-changes rail
items.subtitle: Accepting fades a row out over 100ms, then its height springs shut. The accepted count rolls up. Accept all clears every row in order.

items.title: Figure builder
items.subtitle: Adding a figure drops its caption in and springs every caption to its ranked slot. The page count rolls up with the list.

items.title: Merge preview stepper
items.subtitle: The record title swaps while the field plate slides behind the rows with its far edge trailing 60ms. A missing field rings in the danger color with a note.

items.title: Resolve sweep
items.subtitle: Resolving fades a card and its height springs shut. The open count rolls down after, and the avatar stack fans shut with it.

items.title: Version compare slider
items.subtitle: The divider follows the pointer one to one. On release it springs to the nearer draft, and the caption swaps to match.

items.title: Signature chain
items.subtitle: Advance fills the connector first, then the next seal inks 60ms later. The status swaps forward, ending in Signed.

items.title: Assignment budget board
items.subtitle: Rows spring into their rank slots while the leader plate follows with its far edge trailing 60ms. Killing swaps a row out, then its space collapses; the counts roll to match.

items.title: Headline tester
items.subtitle: Each headline swaps out before the next one swaps in. The winner plate stretches open leading edge first. The click rate rolls over like digits.

items.title: Kill line
items.subtitle: Dragging a story past the cut line arms a red snap. Letting go past the mark fades the row out, then its space closes and the rest spring up. Restore brings it back.

items.title: Query rail
items.subtitle: The rail slides in on a calm spring. New query chips swap in one after another. Resolving one shrinks it away, then the gap closes on the same spring.

items.title: Slug renamer
items.subtitle: The field stretches or shrinks to fit as you type. The old slug blurs into the new one. A taken slug rings red and says so.

items.title: Deck stacker
items.subtitle: Kicker, deck and headline trade places on soft springs with a short trailing edge. The search-result bar fills and inks from green to amber to red as it nears the cut.

items.title: Flatplan paginator
items.subtitle: A held page follows the pointer exactly and bends with rubber-band past the ends. On release it springs into the nearest folio slot, the folio number rolls, and the plate marker trails behind by 60ms. Shuffle re-deals the folio.

items.title: Ship checklist
items.subtitle: Each check fills its box, draws the tick, then runs the strike 40ms later. The ring fills and the count rolls with every step, and the ship button swaps into a success stamp on the last one. Reset clears the board.

items.title: Inbox sweep
items.subtitle: A row follows the finger and arms past 80 pixels. On release it flies out on the fast spring while its gap closes on the calm one, and the count left rolls down. Undo brings the last swept row back.

items.title: Backlink popover
items.subtitle: The popover grows out of the link. Switching tabs swaps the old list out before the new rows rise 30ms apart, and the highlight trails the hovered row by 60ms.

items.title: Tag pill autocomplete
items.subtitle: Typing # filters the list inline: matches spring into their slots while misses blur out. The plate trails the top match by 60ms, and Enter morphs the word into a pill that springs open before its text fades in.

items.title: Streak ring
items.subtitle: The ring fills to its new share. The week dots ink one after another. The day count rolls over. Flipping weeks and months swaps the caption while the ring and dots replay.

items.title: Clip drop target
items.subtitle: Dragging over the card warms its tint. Dropping grows the saved preview down from nothing. The cover starts soft and sharpens, then the title trades places with a saved line and its check.

items.title: Sketch to text
items.subtitle: The ink settles and trades places with typed text. The lines below slide down to make room. Words the reader might doubt blush a warning tint. Retake brings the ink back.

items.title: Outline zoom
items.subtitle: Zooming swaps the breadcrumb trail. The opened branch grows from almost full size. Its children land one after another while the old siblings wash out. Back walks the same path in reverse.

items.title: Recall flip
items.subtitle: The card turns over with a small dip at the halfway point. The answer only swaps in once the question has left. Each grade button trails its edge behind it. The next interval rolls its digits forward.

items.title: Viewer chrome
items.subtitle: The toolbar and counter fade out after two idle seconds. Any pointer movement brings them back on a calm base spring. The page counter rolls its digits; the final page holds a success terminal instead of wrapping.

items.title: Page scrubber
items.subtitle: The knob follows the pointer one-to-one with rubber at the ends and settles on a base spring. The active thumb plate leads while a ghost trails sixty milliseconds behind. The last page tints the caption success.

items.title: In-doc search
items.subtitle: Jumping slides the highlight while its outline trails a beat behind. The match counter rolls digits. A query with no hits blurs out to a quiet empty terminal instead of flashing.

items.title: Redline compare
items.subtitle: Deleted lines fade first and only then does their width close; inserted lines open first and fade in after. The paragraph reflows on a soft spring. Accepting lands a success terminal.

items.title: Signature ceremony
items.subtitle: A pulse travels down the rail to the next open field. Skipping ahead rings the unfinished field in danger. Signing inks a success check and the ceremony holds a signed terminal.

items.title: TOC minimap
items.subtitle: The viewport box tracks the drag one-to-one; a click on the rail springs to that page on a base spring. The caption swaps to the section title and the final section lands an end-of-document terminal.

items.title: Export flow
items.subtitle: The button swaps to a spinner, the bar creeps toward ninety percent on a lazy spring, then springs to full. The pill swaps to a success terminal that holds until the next export.

items.title: Annotation thread
items.subtitle: Resolving inks the check first and only then collapses the thread height on a base spring, landing on a quiet resolved terminal. Reopening plays the same motion in reverse.

items.title: Fillable field
items.subtitle: The label floats up the moment typing starts. An empty required field rings danger with its message; a valid one inks a success check and holds a looks-good terminal.

items.title: Consent checkbox
items.subtitle: Checking fills the box first and the check draws after. The Partial state morphs the check into a dash. A recorded consent holds a success terminal.

items.title: Clause pick-one
items.subtitle: The dot grows from the center of the new clause while the old one shrinks on the same spring. The locked pick carries a success check and the summary swaps to a filed terminal.

items.title: Initial box
items.subtitle: Adopt-and-stamp swaps the ghost for your initials and snaps the stamp from ninety-seven percent on a fast snap spring. The success message holds as the terminal; clearing reverses it.

items.title: Date signed
items.subtitle: The calendar disc glides to the picked day on a base spring while the date blur-swaps in below. Confirming holds a signed-and-dated success terminal.

items.title: Jurisdiction pick
items.subtitle: The list grows down from the trigger on a base spring while the arrow-key highlight trails sixty milliseconds behind the key. The pick swaps into the trigger and holds a filed success terminal.

items.title: Exhibit upload
items.subtitle: The row opens its height first, the bar fills, and only then does the success check ink — or the row rings danger with a retry. Success holds an attached terminal; retry replays the fill.

items.title: Stage spotlight
items.subtitle: The active tile widens on a soft spring while the previous one shrinks on base. A ring follows the speaker and the label swaps. Once everyone has spoken, a success terminal holds.

items.title: Hand-raise queue
items.subtitle: Raised hands rise into the queue staggered 40ms apart on base, each with a rolling order digit. Lowering fades a row out; when the last hand lowers, the header swaps to a clear terminal.

items.title: Breakout shuffle
items.subtitle: Tiles fly from the lobby to room slots staggered on base, room tags swap to seated counts, and a digit clock counts down. At zero a success terminal holds the rooms open.

items.title: Captions roll
items.subtitle: Each new caption rises on base while the oldest swaps out; the speaker name swaps with it. At the end of the segment a success terminal holds the saved transcript.

items.title: Screen-share frame
items.subtitle: The share frame scales in on a lazy ease while the filmstrip highlight trails its edges 60ms behind. The presenter label swaps; stopping lands on an empty terminal.

items.title: Waiting-room admit
items.subtitle: Each row springs shut on base when its guest is admitted, while a green dot pops on snap and the waiting count rolls its digits. The last admit swaps in an empty terminal.

items.title: Reactions burst
items.subtitle: Each tap floats an emoji up on soft while it fades, and the pile below staggers in. Reduced motion skips the float. Five reactions pop a burst terminal; clearing empties the sky.

items.title: Recording dot
items.subtitle: The dot pulses on the clock while tape rolls. Starting swaps in Rec plus a digit timer; stopping swaps back and lands on a saved terminal.

items.title: Call RSVP
items.subtitle: The plate slides behind your pick with its trailing edge 60ms late, and the headcount rolls its digits. Your answer swaps in a terminal you can change.

items.title: Live Q&A upvote
items.subtitle: Voting springs each row to its new rank on base while the counts roll digits. Resolving swaps a row to answered; the last one swaps in an empty terminal.

items.title: Post-call checkout
items.subtitle: Your outcome swaps the follow-up panel; the recap opt-in pops on snap. Submitting swaps in a thanks terminal instead of leaving you hanging.

items.title: Breakpoint morph
items.subtitle: Cards retarget their grid slots with a 30ms stagger when the breakpoint flips, and the wall height springs to fit. The last layout holds settled as the terminal state.

items.title: Split snap drag
items.subtitle: The divider follows the pointer exactly with a grip highlight, then releases into the nearest of three snap points on a soft spring. The readout rolls to the landing percent.

items.title: Grid density switch
items.subtitle: Row height and gap retarget on a soft spring while every row glides to its recomputed slot with a stagger. The pixel measure rolls its digits and the mode swaps over.

items.title: Masonry settle
items.subtitle: Cards are dealt to the shortest column on a base spring with a stagger. Newcomers arrive from 45 percent opacity with blur, and the wall height trails on a lazy spring. A full wall holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Sticky stacking
items.subtitle: Sticky headers pin and push off one to one while the section name swaps over and a marker trails 60ms behind. Reaching the end holds a done state.

items.title: Holy-grail reorder
items.subtitle: Narrow stacks both sidebars below the article on slot springs with a stagger, and focus moves into the article so tab order matches the visual order. Wide restores the three columns.

items.title: Empty-column collapse
items.subtitle: The empty column width springs to zero on a base spring while its siblings expand to fill the freed space. Refilling reverses the motion, and each end state holds settled.

items.title: Multi-column flow
items.subtitle: Fields reflow between two columns and one with FLIP springs, so nothing jumps. An empty email swaps its error in and pushes the rows below on springs. A clean save holds a success terminal.

items.title: Fieldset grouping
items.subtitle: Toggling the group springs its height with the chevron turning alongside. Validating an empty group snaps an invalid ring on; a checked group settles a success ring as its terminal.

items.title: Suggestion chips
items.subtitle: Chips stagger in 40ms apart. The tapped chip morphs into your bubble while siblings blur out, and the reply fades up as the terminal state.

items.title: Tool-call disclosure
items.subtitle: The row expands on a soft spring while each step trails in. Its spinner swaps to a check on done, and the caption settles on a success terminal.

items.title: Confidence meter
items.subtitle: The thin meter inks on a lazy spring while digits roll the percent. The band caption swaps between danger, warning and success terminals.

items.title: Voice waveform
items.subtitle: Bars pulse live off the clock while held. On release they spring back and the transcript bubble swaps in as the terminal state.

items.title: Human handoff
items.subtitle: The avatar swaps to your teammate while the queue pill drops in on base. Digits count the wait down, then the transcript unfolds to a joined terminal.

items.title: Regeneration diff
items.subtitle: The old answer blurs out while the new one swaps in. Changed phrases glow, then fade, and the card height springs to fit.

items.title: Citation popover
items.subtitle: The number pops on snap while the panel grows on base. Sources stagger 30ms apart, and tapping outside closes everything faster.

items.title: Memory toggle
items.subtitle: The knob slides with trailing edges on base. The saved-fact chip opens its width first, then the text fades in as the terminal state.

items.title: In-chat poll
items.subtitle: Each option morphs in place into its result bar. Fills stagger in, percents roll their digits, and the picked row keeps its check.

items.title: Thumbs plus reason
items.subtitle: The pressed thumb sinks on snap. The reason field opens its height on soft, and Send swaps the row to a thank-you terminal.

items.title: CSAT in chat
items.subtitle: Faces rise in on soft with a stagger. One mood value drives the big face, so hovering reads as a single expression changing. The caption swaps per score.

items.title: Slot-filling form
items.subtitle: Missing slots stack compact while the first open one offers picks. Each answer inks a check and collapses, and the progress edge trails to a booked terminal.

items.title: Slot picker
items.subtitle: The day plate glides across with its trailing edge lagging behind. Old times blur out while the new day staggers in cell by cell. A picked slot holds its ink border as the terminal.

items.title: Timezone flip
items.subtitle: Each time blurs out and its replacement blurs in. The time column measures the longest new label and springs to fit it, so nothing jumps. Filtering to working hours only fades the late row.

items.title: Availability heatmap
items.subtitle: Cells rest in soft green-amber tints by free count. Hovering swaps the dot for the count; clicking inks a booking ring that holds. Switching team and mine re-tints every cell.

items.title: Hold to confirm a booking
items.subtitle: Holding fills the ring at a steady pace. Letting go early springs the fill back to zero. A full hold swaps the arrow for a check and the card holds its success tint as the terminal.

items.title: Reschedule drag
items.subtitle: The chip follows your finger one to one. A gap opens softly at the landing slot while the others spring aside, and the chip label swaps to the snapped time on drop.

items.title: Group-poll tally
items.subtitle: Tapping an option morphs every row into its result bar. Fills stagger down the list, counts roll on digits, and the leader inks a success tint that holds as the terminal.

items.title: Buffer editor
items.subtitle: The right handle drags the event edge one to one while the buffer edge trails sixty milliseconds behind. Syncing pulses the dot, then swaps Scheduled to Synced — or Conflict when the buffer runs under fifteen minutes.

items.title: Attendee fields
items.subtitle: Each field validates as you type. A bad value rings the field red and swaps in its message; a good one earns a success check. Sending with errors surfaces every message, and a clean invite holds its success state.

items.title: Intake questions
items.subtitle: Each answer slides the next question up from below while the progress bar fills. Continuing empty snaps the card side to side and swaps in what is missing. The sent summary holds as the terminal.

items.title: RSVP
items.subtitle: One plate slides between yes, no and maybe. Counts roll on digits with every vote, yes inks success and maybe holds a warning tint instead of ever resolving green.

items.title: Place card sheet
items.subtitle: The sheet drags through peek, half and full and settles on the nearest stop on a soft spring. Photos cross-fade while the rating rolls its digits. The map never moves.

items.title: Route comparison
items.subtitle: Rival inks chase each other with the trailing edge 60ms behind. The winner plate lands leading-edge-first. ETAs roll on a base spring and the loser holds dimmed as the terminal.

items.title: Geofence ring
items.subtitle: Entering snaps two pulses out from the ring, then the ring settles soft and the label swaps to Inside. Leaving runs the same motion in reverse and rests Outside.

items.title: Layer switcher
items.subtitle: Chips morph a plate whose trailing edge arrives 60ms late. Old tiles cross-fade while the new layer blooms from 0.97 on base. Pins ride above it all.

items.title: Location search
items.subtitle: Matches stagger in on snap and their pins drop in reading order. A miss swaps to the no-match line and the count rolls to zero. The last result holds as the terminal.

items.title: Itinerary timeline
items.subtitle: One scrub value inks the route, rolls the clock and the miles together. Stop photos swap in lazy as the marker passes them. Releasing at the end holds Done.

items.title: Offline pack
items.subtitle: The ring fills on base while the percent rolls with it. At 100 the label swaps to a check, the sheet drops soft and tiles fade in top-down. Done holds as the terminal.

items.title: Crowd heat overlay
items.subtitle: Cells bloom in lazy and cross-fade. Dense cells pulse once and rest. Toggling off fades the heat and brings the pins back on base.

items.title: Address fields
items.subtitle: The verified plate glides with its trailing edge late. Typing swaps the suggestion on snap. A bad ZIP shakes the row on snap and the error holds as the terminal.

items.title: Place rating
items.subtitle: Stars ink left-to-right on base. The chip morphs its width and the count rolls its digits. Skip swaps the hint and rests unrated as the terminal.

items.title: Trip polls
items.subtitle: Votes stack their bars soft with trailing edges. The leader tint slides to the new front-runner. Totals roll digits and your vote swaps to a check. The tally holds as the terminal.

items.title: Live value ticker
items.subtitle: Only changed digits roll toward the new value while an up or down tint cross-fades in and drains away. Every slot keeps its width, so the row never shifts.

items.title: Update flash
items.subtitle: A fresh cell gets a soft tint wash that fades on the lazy spring while its value swaps underneath. Rows keep fixed height, so nothing ever moves.

items.title: Pause-live buffer
items.subtitle: Freeze raises a paused pill with a rolling backlog count. Resume drains the backlog top-down with stagger, then the pill settles back to live.

items.title: Delta arrows
items.subtitle: The arrow turns through base as the chip swaps sign, the tint cross-fades success to danger, and the pill width springs to fit. The flat state holds as terminal.

items.title: Streaming log tail
items.subtitle: A new row opens its height first, then fades up into place while older rows spring down. The tail auto-sticks unless you scrolled up to read back.

items.title: Heartbeat status
items.subtitle: The dot breathes on a slow clock while live. As health degrades the dot morphs warning to danger and the label swaps with it. When reports stop, the status goes stale: the dot turns gray and stops breathing, so a silent feed never reads as live. The pass ends settled on live.

items.title: Catch-up burst
items.subtitle: Reconnect ticks the backlog on in one fast stagger wave: digits roll together, rows flash once, and the pill settles back to live. Dropped state holds until you reconnect.

items.title: Live poll
items.subtitle: A vote morphs each option into its result bar with stagger. Percentages roll up together, and the chosen row keeps its check. It ends counted and settled.

items.title: Prediction question
items.subtitle: A pick presses in, then fills while the odds bar stretches leading-edge-first and the caption swaps to locked. The lock holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Slider with histogram
items.subtitle: The thumb follows the pointer exactly. Bars at or under the value snap to ink, the rest fade, and the number rolls. Release settles on a set terminal.

items.title: Audit health dial
items.subtitle: Two concentric rings fill on the same soft spring while the composite score rolls its digits. The verdict swaps in only once the run settles, and holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Issue severity list
items.subtitle: Rows arrive staggered 60ms apart on base. Tapping a row expands its measured fix-it panel; resolving fades the card and springs its height shut while the open count rolls down. Zero issues swaps in the terminal all-clear.

items.title: Crawl progress
items.subtitle: The counter rides the lazy spring toward 90%, creeps there, then snaps to 100% with a success tint. Each log line swaps in as its batch lands, and the status holds on the terminal complete state.

items.title: Position tracker
items.subtitle: The sparkline draws on the lazy spring while the rank digits roll up or down. The delta chip swaps to success or danger, and the badge holds the new rank as the terminal state.

items.title: Snippet preview editor
items.subtitle: Desktop and mobile tabs morph the preview height on base while the title and description swap with blur as you type. The rich-result row fades in and out, and the truncated preview holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Sitemap tree
items.subtitle: Folders open with height and chevron riding the same base spring, so they never disagree. Orphaned pages carry a warning tint, and the selection pill trails the tapped row on lagging edges.

items.title: Backlink flow
items.subtitle: Edges draw source-first on the lazy spring, one after another. Hovering a source thickens its edge on snap and swaps the detail card; the last inspected link holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Core vitals bars
items.subtitle: Bars stagger in on base while each value rolls its millisecond digits. Threshold bands sit behind the bars in danger, warning and success; the verdict swaps once every bar has settled and holds.

items.title: Site-audit intake
items.subtitle: One question per panel: the old panel slides out with blur before the next slides in, and the progress bar fills on the same spring. A valid URL earns the success check; the final panel holds the queued terminal state.

items.title: Redirect-rule builder
items.subtitle: Rows spring to their slots when reordered. The regex toggle swaps its help line with blur, and an invalid source rings the field in danger with its message. All-valid swaps the terminal confirmation.

items.title: Coachmark sequence
items.subtitle: The card is one box whose leading edge moves first and trailing edge follows 60ms later, so it stretches toward its dot. Copy slides in the direction you travel. The last card holds as a success terminal.

items.title: Checklist beacon
items.subtitle: The pill folds into a list whose height springs open. The segmented bar runs a leading edge now and a trailing edge 60ms behind, and the count rolls. All four done swaps the header to a success pill that holds.

items.title: Empty nudge
items.subtitle: The empty art breathes on a slow clock while the CTA rings once, then goes quiet. Tips rotate underneath on a timer. Creating a report swaps the whole card to a success terminal that holds.

items.title: Feature beacon
items.subtitle: The dot breathes on a soft loop. Clicking springs the hint open and freezes the pulse; Esc snaps it shut. Got it closes and checks the dot, a success terminal that holds.

items.title: Shortcut sheet
items.subtitle: Holding springs the sheet up; each keycap snaps down under the pointer and the grid swaps by category. Letting go snaps shut instantly — the resting state is the terminal.

items.title: Hint bubble
items.subtitle: The bubble rises beside the focused field and glides field to field with both edges trailing 60ms behind; only its text swaps. Typing snaps it shut — the quiet form is the terminal.

items.title: Save meter
items.subtitle: Every tick moves the leading edge now and drags the trailing edge 60ms behind while the percent rolls. A full form swaps the label to a Saved success pill that holds.

items.title: Undo toast
items.subtitle: Archiving collapses the step on a height spring while the toast rises; its ring drains over six seconds. Undo restores the height and swaps a check in. Expiry or Undo both land in a quiet terminal.

items.title: Goal router
items.subtitle: Tapping a goal dips the card on a fast snap, then swaps to the branch that goal routes to while the step rolls forward. Every path ends in a Got-it terminal with a Start-over.

items.title: Preference picker
items.subtitle: Chips fill-toggle on a calm base spring while the picked count rolls. The digest preview swaps live between empty, light and full — full holds as the success terminal.

items.title: Setup wizard
items.subtitle: The segmented thumb trails its edges across three or four steps while panels swap in the direction you travel. Team and personal branch apart; Done and Skipped both hold as terminals.

items.title: Segmented view switch
items.subtitle: The plate stretches from its leading edge and the trailing edge catches up 60ms later. The old heading leaves before the new heading and rows arrive 50ms apart. The shell height springs to fit, and the count rolls.

items.title: Bottom-sheet detents
items.subtitle: The sheet tracks the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands past its stops. Release velocity picks the detent: a fast fling up lands full, down lands half. The dim only fades in at full and the stops hold as terminals.

items.title: Drill-in navigation
items.subtitle: The new pane slides in from the trailing edge while the current one shifts 28px and dims. The back label swaps to the parent title and the tab bar never moves. An edge swipe tracks the finger and commits or cancels on release.

items.title: Tab state restore
items.subtitle: Tabs swap with no travel: the old pane leaves, then the new one arrives. Each tab restores its scroll position and stack depth instantly. The indicator stretches leading-edge-first and badges roll down to zero.

items.title: Split-view divider
items.subtitle: The divider tracks the finger 1:1 and rubber-bands at the minimum widths. On release both panes spring soft together to the nearest stop. Dragged under 100px the master collapses into an overlay with a dim.

items.title: Pull-to-refresh arm
items.subtitle: The header stretches with rising resistance the further you pull. Past the threshold the arrow turns into a release cue. Let go and the spinner holds while fresh rows height-spring in one by one, landing on an updated terminal.

items.title: View crossfade
items.subtitle: The header stays pinned while the old and new views overlap and fade through each other with a soft blur. Body text swaps on the way through. Nothing travels, so the frame never shifts.

items.title: Deep-link landing
items.subtitle: Tapping a link builds the full stack instantly with no travel, then the final pane enters heading-first and body 50ms later. The back chain lands on the correct parent every step, ending home.

items.title: Multi-step form shell
items.subtitle: The chrome and progress bar never move while panels swap in the direction you travel. The shell height springs to each panel. Going back restores what you typed, and the final step morphs into a success terminal.

items.title: Stepper header
items.subtitle: The active plate glides with its leading edge first. The connector fills toward the new step, then the node inks. Finished steps swap their numbers for checks, and extra steps fade at the scrolled edges.

items.title: Shelf carousel
items.subtitle: The shelf follows a drag 1:1 and rubber-bands past the edges, then settles to the nearest card. Dots roll with the shelf and peek cards trail in 60ms apart.

items.title: Variant swatch morph
items.subtitle: The selection ring glides with its trailing edge 60ms behind. The sold-out swatch fades and a slash draws across it. The name blur-swaps.

items.title: Stock countdown
items.subtitle: The bar drains lazily and only changed digits roll. At 5 left the low pill pops in and the message swaps to order soon. Zero holds as sold out.

items.title: Offer banner stack
items.subtitle: Promos rest pushed back in depth. The top card follows a drag and flings away on velocity, else springs home. Dismissing all holds a done terminal with undo.

items.title: QR checkout
items.subtitle: The code rests at 96% and springs to full on open while a beam sweeps on the clock. Paid swaps in a check and the total counts up to a held terminal.

items.title: Loyalty stamp card
items.subtitle: A stamp presses to 80% then fills softly while digits roll. The sixth stamp swaps the card into a reward pill that holds as the terminal.

items.title: Review stars input
items.subtitle: Fill follows the pointer while held, then settles on release. The caption swaps to the score and submit morphs into a held thanks.

items.title: Pickup time picker
items.subtitle: The day disc glides under the new day while slots blur-swap 60ms apart. The chosen chip lifts onto a plate that stretches to it.

items.title: Checkout fields
items.subtitle: Labels snap up on focus or fill. An invalid submit rings danger and swaps in a message; fixing a field swaps it out and stamps a success check that holds.

items.title: Address form
items.subtitle: Switching country cross-fades the field set while the wrapper height springs to fit. Typing a known postcode swaps the city in with blur.

items.title: Review form
items.subtitle: Photo tiles open their height first and sharpen after. Faces glide with the mood and the label swaps; posting morphs a held thanks.

items.title: Preference quiz
items.subtitle: Cards slide in the direction of travel with a blur swap while progress fills. The result swaps into a mini shelf that holds as the terminal.

items.title: Hero word rotator
items.subtitle: The keyword slot cycles every 2.8s: the old word blurs up and out, the next rises in, and the pill width springs to fit. With loop off the last word holds as the terminal state.

items.title: Logo marquee
items.subtitle: The strip loops seamlessly with faded edges. Hovering eases the speed to a full stop on a soft spring and leaving restores it; scrolling it offscreen freezes the offset entirely.

items.title: Stat count-up
items.subtitle: The count fires once when half the tile is visible and rides lazy rolling digits to the total. Only after the number settles does the caption swap from counting to the final label: the settled terminal state.

items.title: Testimonial deck
items.subtitle: The stack fans beneath the top card as it is dragged. A fast fling or far drag dismisses it and the next quote swaps in; a short drag springs home. The last card settles into a done state with a restart.

items.title: Pricing toggle morph
items.subtitle: The thumb glides with a 60ms trailing edge, the changed price rolls on its own digits, and the tier card lifts and tints on yearly while the savings pill pops in: the yearly terminal holds all three.

items.title: FAQ accordion
items.subtitle: One row opens at a time with the body height on a spring and the chevron turning on the same spring. Closed rows dim while one is open; a #faq deep link opens its row instantly with no animation.

items.title: Email capture
items.subtitle: Submit settles into neutral, invalid or valid. Invalid rings the field danger with a swapped message; valid spins the button, lands a check, and holds the success pill as the terminal state.

items.title: Sticky CTA reveal
items.subtitle: Scrolling past the hero drops the bar in on a spring; nearing the footer sends it back up. The bar label swaps with the plan picker, so the call to action always names the chosen terminal plan.

items.title: Spring playground
items.subtitle: Snap, base, soft and lazy side by side. Drag the dot and release: velocity carries into every spring, each settling at its own rate.

items.title: Easing compare
items.subtitle: The same move on three springs: base arrives clean, emphasized leans in with a breath of overshoot, smooth takes its time.

items.title: Duration ladder
items.subtitle: Four durations from snappy to ambient. Each step runs its own spring; the millisecond labels roll on Digits.

items.title: Stagger lab
items.subtitle: Compose a stagger: dial the per-item delay and flip the order. Below, kept separate, the 60ms edge trail follows every slide.

items.title: Reduced-motion simulator
items.subtitle: Flip the switch and the same demo goes instant: the dot jumps, the label swaps with no blur. State is kept, motion is not.

items.title: Token inspector
items.subtitle: Spring, swap, lag and digits tokens in one panel. The probe below runs the picked spring so the numbers stay honest.

items.title: Curve exporter
items.subtitle: Pick a spring and a platform: the same curve as CSS, SwiftUI or Reanimated values, copied in one click.

items.title: Frame meter
items.subtitle: Start the spring and watch real frame times roll in. Anything over 25ms counts as dropped.

items.title: Focus ring
items.subtitle: A single snap ring frames whichever input has focus. Theme and width stay consistent everywhere by construction.

items.title: Press states
items.subtitle: The universal press: snap in under the finger, spring back on release. Force only changes how deep it dips.

items.title: Validation shake
items.subtitle: Failed validation shakes the field, rings it in danger and swaps in the message. Distance is the only dial; everything else is fixed.

items.title: Inline success
items.subtitle: A valid address shrinks the button into a spinner, then morphs it into a success pill. The count rides digits to the subscriber total and a referral line swaps in. The success state holds.

items.title: Tier picker
items.subtitle: The plate glides with a trailing edge. Only changed price digits roll, benefits blur-swap and the savings pill pops in on the soft spring. Yearly holds as the terminal.

items.title: Referral progress
items.subtitle: The bar fills on the lazy spring, milestone nodes ink 60ms apart, the count rides digits and the reward swaps to a check. Five of five holds.

items.title: Issue archive
items.subtitle: The open row springs to its measured height while its chevron turns. The next row headlines swap with a 40ms stagger. One open row holds.

items.title: Preview-text editor
items.subtitle: Typing past the client cut truncates the preview where phones and desktops stop. The length bar snaps between success, warning and danger. Switching device swaps the frame.

items.title: Embed card
items.subtitle: The card grows from 97% of the trigger. A valid submit blur-swaps to a success check, then collapses to a referral row that holds.

items.title: Reader poll
items.subtitle: A vote morphs each option into its result bar with a 50ms stagger. Percents ride the lazy spring and the chosen row keeps its check.

items.title: Paywall meter
items.subtitle: Each read rides the lazy arc down. At one left the verdict swaps to a warning, at zero it locks and the gate lifts top-to-bottom to reveal the offer.

items.title: Signup fields
items.subtitle: Labels float on focus. A complete field snaps a success check; an incomplete one rings danger with a message. A valid form holds subscribed.

items.title: Preference center
items.subtitle: The parent morphs between check and dash on one spring for the mixed state. Children stagger in and the frequency note blur-swaps. Saved holds.

items.title: Reader survey
items.subtitle: Panels slide sideways between questions while progress fills. Thanks morphs to a success tint with a digit count. The count holds.

items.title: Command palette drop
items.subtitle: Palette drops on a soft spring. Rows spring to their slots while misses blur out. The highlight plate trails its edges by 60ms. Running a command holds a success terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Omnibox suggestions
items.subtitle: Suggestion list height springs to the match count. Matches spring in with bolded letters while the plate slides with lagging edges. Opening a result holds a success terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Tab hover cards
items.subtitle: Hover rests 300ms, then the card rises on a base spring at 97% rest height. Moving tab-to-tab glides position while the preview swap-blurs. Pinning holds a terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Split-view toggle
items.subtitle: Divider tracks the pointer 1:1 while dragging. On release panes spring aside with velocity and the preset pill slides with trailing edges. A preset holds the terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Downloads shelf
items.subtitle: The shelf pushes up on a base spring. Rows stagger in every 40ms while each ring fills live, then swap-blurs to a success check with rolling digits. All complete holds the terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Profile switcher
items.subtitle: Avatar ring inks on a base spring. The panel swaps identity with blur while width springs to the longest name. Esc snaps shut on snap. Switching holds the terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Extension popover
items.subtitle: Popover grows from the toolbar icon on base and snaps shut faster on snap. Rows fade in staggered 25ms with the danger row tinted. Choosing holds a terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Find-in-page bar
items.subtitle: Bar drops top-right on snap. Match digits roll up or down by travel direction while the current-match plate stretches with trailing edges. Last match holds the terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Settings search filter
items.subtitle: Sections filter in place while misses blur out. Closed section heights spring shut and the highlight plate rides the arrow keys. Jumping to a section holds the terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Settings form row
items.subtitle: Toggle knob rides on base edges. Helper text swap-blurs between hint, danger, and success states. Invalid tints danger with a message; valid holds a success check terminal. Reduced motion jumps instantly.

items.title: Cart drawer
items.subtitle: The drawer slides in on the base spring over a fading scrim while rows trail 40ms apart. The free-shipping bar fills and the savings line swaps to its success terminal. Checkout stays pinned.

items.title: Quantity stepper
items.subtitle: Digits roll on the base spring in the step direction. At zero the row collapses its height, then leaves an undo terminal. Every money value springs to the new total together.

items.title: Promo code
items.subtitle: The field grows open on the base spring. Apply spins, then the success chip width-springs in while the discount rolls. A bad code rings danger with an inline fix, never only at submit.

items.title: Shipping method
items.subtitle: The dot scales in on the base spring while the card lifts and its border inks. The price delta rolls and the ETA swaps. The cheapest option carries the free-over threshold pill.

items.title: Gift wrap
items.subtitle: The knob edges across like a switch while the note height-springs open and the bow draws itself softly. The fee rolls in place without moving the switch.

items.title: Tax estimator
items.subtitle: The ZIP estimator opens on the base height spring. Estimate swaps in itemized rows 50ms apart while every money value springs to its figure together.

items.title: Express pay sheet
items.subtitle: Wallet buttons fade up staggered once ready. The sheet rises on the base spring carrying line-items, options and coupon inside. Confirm fills toward success and holds its receipt terminal.

items.title: Tracking timeline
items.subtitle: The spine fills on the lazy spring to the current stop while each node inks 60ms after arrival. The ETA digits roll down. Delivered draws its check and swaps to the receipt terminal.

items.title: Payment fields
items.subtitle: Spaces land every four digits while the brand swaps live. Valid fields earn a success check inline; invalid ones ring danger with a fix, as you type — never submit-only. Pay holds its terminal.

items.title: Address autocomplete
items.subtitle: Rows filter in place: matches spring into their slots while misses blur out. Picking swaps in the full address and collapses the list height to a receipt terminal.

items.title: Delivery instructions
items.subtitle: The link opens the textarea on the base height spring while the counter warns past 90%. Save swaps to a compact chip with Edit; saving empty leaves zero trace.

items.title: Toast stack pile
items.subtitle: Newest slides in on base while older ones sink with soft depth. Hovering expands the pile and pauses timers; toasts announce politely, errors assertively.

items.title: Hover intent card
items.subtitle: A slow approach that rests opens after a beat; a fast pass never opens. A safe triangle between link and card keeps it open, and keyboard focus pins it.

items.title: Context submenu
items.subtitle: The child slides 12px from the parent edge on base while edges trail 60ms. The parent stays put, the arrow turns, and Esc steps back one level.

items.title: Modal from trigger
items.subtitle: The modal grows from the trigger rect on base while the scrim fades. Closing snaps back into the trigger faster, and focus returns to it.

items.title: Velocity drawer
items.subtitle: The drawer tracks the drag 1:1 and release velocity picks open or closed. The scrim fades with position and links stagger only after it settles.
