items.title: Caret tooltip
items.subtitle: The tip anchors to the caret with a snap, then glides word to word on base as you type. Text swaps per word and focus never leaves the field.

items.title: Hold scrim dismiss
items.subtitle: Pressing dims the scrim deeper as a snap preview. Holding 500ms dismisses; releasing early springs back. Space held works the same.

items.title: Dialog form steps
items.subtitle: Header and footer stay pinned while only the body swaps on base. Invalid fields turn danger with a message, valid ones show a success check.

items.title: Bundle sweep
items.subtitle: Done archives the promo cluster. Rows blur out in place, then the gap closes on base while the count rolls to zero and a success terminal holds.

items.title: Snooze sheet
items.subtitle: The sheet rises on base and time chips stagger in every 40ms. Picking one collapses the top row, which returns on soft as a snoozed terminal.

items.title: Send-later dial
items.subtitle: A long press opens a radial dial on soft. Dragging sets the time 1:1 and the label swaps behind it. Release confirms with a snap to a scheduled terminal.

items.title: Branch fold
items.subtitle: Quoted ancestry collapses into an indented tree. Connectors draw on lazy while the chevron turns on base, and the count swaps between show and hide.

items.title: Attachment strip
items.subtitle: Rail thumbs fan in with a 30ms stagger on base. Tapping one grows the preview radius on a spring, and the overflow count rolls as the set drains.

items.title: Follow-up nudge
items.subtitle: The no-reply warning drops in and pushes the thread down on base. Setting a reminder swaps a spinner into a success check terminal.

items.title: Split tabs
items.subtitle: Tab edges trail 60ms behind the pick while counts roll down as mail is triaged. The empty split fades in and its width springs shut to fit.

items.title: Command-K jump
items.subtitle: An email-scoped palette where rows spring into slots as you type, the highlight trails on lagging edges, and the preview swaps behind the pick.

items.title: Compose fields
items.subtitle: Recipient chips open width-first and the text fades in after. Bad addresses flag danger with a message; good ones settle into a success check terminal.

items.title: Template variables
items.subtitle: The snippet pill inks on base while values swap into fixed-width slots, so nothing jumps. The missing date pulses a warning until it is filled.

items.title: Poll by email
items.subtitle: Vote bars fill with a base stagger while percents fade in lazy. The pick keeps its check, the tally rolls its digits, and votes can move.

items.title: Presence avatars
items.subtitle: A joiner pops in at 60% scale and fans the stack out with stagger. A leaver shrinks in place, then the gap springs closed. The owner keeps a ring.

items.title: Hold to confirm a deletion
items.subtitle: The danger confirm slides in on base after the dialog. Hold-to-confirm runs a digits countdown, then the row collapses only after exit.

items.title: Sheet detents
items.subtitle: Sheet rests at peek, half or full detents on base. A fast flick skips the middle detent. The grabber stays visible and the page behind stays inert.

items.title: Magic link
items.subtitle: Send delivers a link state and starts a 30 second resend countdown. Hammering resend never starts two timers: each send carries a guard token and stale ticks are ignored.

items.title: MFA challenge
items.subtitle: Six boxes mirror one input and a wrong code clears itself after a beat. The recovery toggle swaps the boxes for a single field that forgives spaces and dashes.

items.title: Password reset
items.subtitle: Request swaps to a confirm step with a live strength meter. Short passwords stay on the step with a text error; a strong save lands a confirmation.

items.title: Passkey sign in
items.subtitle: The button busies with waiting text while the ceremony runs, then lands a signed-in status. Flipping the toggle reveals the fallback note and parks the button.

items.title: Single sign-on
items.subtitle: Each provider owns its accessible name. A press busies that button with connecting text; the first attempt lands an inline error and the retry signs in.

items.title: Org invite
items.subtitle: Accept lands a welcome line while decline arms an inline confirm step. Keep returns to the invite; every ending is text, never color alone.

items.title: Sessions
items.subtitle: Each row names its device and city. The current row reads This device and carries no revoke button; revoking any other row removes it and says so in text.

items.title: Account
items.subtitle: Sign out opens an inline Sign out of all devices step with Confirm and Cancel. Confirm lands a signed-out line; Cancel returns to the profile untouched.

items.title: Voice note player
items.subtitle: Play and pause are one shape on one spring. The waveform fills continuously with the playhead, the speed button swaps 1x, 1.5x and 2x without a jump in position, and dragging or the arrow keys scrub.

items.title: Voice recorder
items.subtitle: Tapping the mic grows the pill into live level bars and rolling mm:ss digits. Cancel collapses it back. Stop springs the bars from the live heights into a static waveform and the pill becomes a clip card.

items.title: Transcript follow-along
items.subtitle: A highlight pill glides from word to word as a simulated clock plays, taking each word's own box so it stretches across long and short words. Tapping any word moves the clock there and keeps playing.

items.title: Audio room
items.subtitle: Speaker tiles breathe with simulated voice levels. A join springs every tile to its new slot, raising a hand pops a badge past its rest size, and muting draws a slash across the mic while the ring settles.

items.title: Threaded replies
items.subtitle: A post with a rail that runs from the parent avatar and curves into each reply. The like and repost counts roll digit by digit, and View 3 more replies opens the nested replies on a height spring while the rail grows with them.

items.title: Reaction picker
items.subtitle: The picker row rises staggered from the smile button. The chosen emoji flies to its summary chip on a spring and the count rolls when it lands; picking again, or tapping your own chip, takes the reaction back.

items.title: Voice reply in a thread
items.subtitle: The mic in the composer swaps the text field for live level bars and rolling digits. Stop sends the clip into the thread as a new reply that rises in on a height spring and carries its own mini player; typed replies land the same way.

items.title: Link preview unfurl
items.subtitle: Pasting a URL opens a reserved slot with a pulsing skeleton, then the real card cross-fades in with its image, domain and two-line title. The slot height springs to the card and the remove button collapses it again.

items.title: Typing to message
items.subtitle: Your message rises into the thread, then three dots wave on a phase offset. When the reply arrives the same bubble grows to the measured size of the text and the words fade in.

items.title: Delivery ticks
items.subtitle: The clock hand turns while sending. A first check draws in on Sent, a second slides in beside it on Delivered, both turn to the accent color on Read, then the Seen by avatars slide in one after another.

items.title: Inbox reorder
items.subtitle: A new message makes its conversation slide to the top while every row in between slides down by one slot. Its unread badge pops past full size and the count rolls; opening the conversation shrinks the badge away.

items.title: Group avatar
items.subtitle: Every member circle springs between layout slots as people join: one fills the circle, two split diagonally, three form a triangle, four tile a grid, and past four the fourth slot becomes a plus count that rolls.

items.title: Pin and comment review
items.subtitle: In comment mode a crosshair follows the pointer or the arrow keys, and a click drops a numbered pin that pops past its rest size. A popover opens beside it and flips to the other side near the edge; Post turns the pin solid and Resolve fades it away.

items.title: Helpful thumbs
items.subtitle: Choosing a thumb swaps the question for reason chips that fit that answer, and sending swaps in a thank-you that repeats what was chosen. The panel height springs to the measured size of each step instead of jumping.
